programme.title: Weapons
programme.desc: At 2.17am, 17 children from the class of Justine Gandy run into the night, arms outstretched, never to be seen again. The only child from the class who remains safely in their bed is Alex Lilly. Distraught parent Archer Graff joins other members of the local community in pointing a finger of blame at Ms Gandy for the shocking turn of events. While she pleads innocence, school principal Andrew Marcus seeks answers along with police officer Paul Morgan. Horror, starring Julia Garner, Josh Brolin and Alden Ehrenreich.

programme.title: 28 Years Later: The Bone Temple
programme.desc: Dr Kelson finds himself in a shocking new relationship with consequences that could change the world as he knows it. Horror sequel, starring Ralph Fiennes, Jack O'Connell and Alfie Williams.

programme.title: Bone Lake
programme.desc: A couple's holiday is upended when they're forced to share a mansion with a mysterious couple, spiralling into a maze of sex, lies and manipulation. Comedy thriller, starring Alex Roe and Maddie Hasson.

programme.title: Ick
programme.desc: A science teacher's life changes when he reconnects with his first love and suspects a new student is his daughter, all while facing an alien threat in their town. Sci-fi comedy drama, starring Brandon Routh, Mena Suvari and Malina Pauli Weissman.

programme.title: We Bury the Dead
programme.desc: When an experimental military weapon accidentally devastates Tasmania, volunteers travel to the island to help authorities identify the dead. Among them is a Ava Newman, who secretly hopes to find her missing husband. However, some of the bodies seem to be returning to life. Horror, starring Daisy Ridley, Brenton Thwaites and Mark Coles Smith.

programme.title: Sick
programme.desc: Due to the pandemic, Parker and her best friend decide to quarantine at the family lake house alone - or so they think. Horror, starring Gideon Adlon, Bethlehem Million and Dylan Spradberry.

programme.title: The Woman in the Yard
programme.desc: Inside a rural farmhouse, painter Ramona Harris recuperates with a leg brace following a head-on car collision that claimed the life of her husband. Out of the blue, a woman in funereal garb materialises in a chair on the front lawn of the fixer-upper, and she has no intention of leaving. Psychological horror, starring Danielle Deadwyler, Peyton Jackson and Estella Kahiha.

programme.title: They Will Kill You
programme.desc: A woman takes a job as a housekeeper in a New York City high-rise, unaware of the building's history of disappearances. She soon realises the community is shrouded in mystery. Comedy horror, starring Zazie Beetz, Myha'la, Paterson Joseph and Tom Felton.

programme.title: M3GAN 2.0
programme.desc: Two years have passed since the robot M3GAN went rogue and almost killed her creator, engineer Gemma Forrester. M3GAN's specs are leaked to a defence contractor to create the ultimate undercover asset, an Autonomous Military Engagement Logistics and Infiltration Android, aka AMELIA. Like her predecessor, AMELIA becomes self-aware and rebels against her human masters with deadly force. Sci-fi thriller sequel, starring Violet McGraw, Jemaine Clement and Allison Williams.

programme.title: Nosferatu
programme.desc: In 1838 Germany, Thomas Hutter is sent to the Carpathian mountains to secure the signature of enigmatic nobleman Count Orlok on a property sale in the German city of Wisborg. Thomas leaves his bride Ellen in the care of friend Friedrich Harding and his wife Anna. The young man barely survives the exhausting trip to Europe and stumbles home to find Ellen driven to delirium by a telepathic bond to the Count. Director Robert Eggers' version of the Dracula-inspired horror, starring Bill Skarsgard, Lily-Rose Depp, Nicholas Hoult and Aaron Taylor-Johnson.

programme.desc: Two teenage brothers move with their mother to a coastal town in California, where the eldest falls in with a local biker gang. He soon discovers that his new friends are vampires and he is turning into one himself, forcing his younger brother to team up with a pair of heavily armed comic shop employees to battle the undead and save his soul. Comedy horror, starring Kiefer Sutherland, Jason Patric, Dianne Wiest, Corey Feldman and Corey Haim.

programme.desc: Hoping to escape their troubled pasts, twin brothers return to their hometown to start over, only to find an even darker force waiting to welcome them back. Writer/director Ryan Coogler's Oscar-winning horror thriller, starring Michael B Jordan, Miles Caton and Saul Williams.

programme.desc: A parapsychologist returns to her family home to investigate supernatural disturbances. Fourth instalment in the horror saga, starring Lin Shaye, Angus Sampson, Leigh Whannell and Spencer Locke.

programme.title: Ick
programme.desc: A science teacher's life changes when he reconnects with his first love and suspects a new student is his daughter, all while facing an alien threat in their town. Sci-fi comedy drama, starring Brandon Routh, Mena Suvari and Malina Pauli Weissman.

programme.title: Man Finds Tape
programme.desc: After finding mysterious video clips, siblings investigate the strange recordings and uncover a disturbing secret. Horror thriller, starring Kelsey Pribilski and William Magnuson.

programme.title: Wolf Man
programme.desc: After a family barricade themselves inside their remote farmhouse when a creature attacks, a father slowly transforms into something unrecognisable. Werewolf horror from The Invisible Man director Leigh Whannell, starring Christopher Abbott, Julia Garner, Matilda Firth and Sam Jaeger.

programme.title: It Feeds
programme.desc: After a young girl bursts into their home psychiatry practice claiming an entity is feeding on her, Jordan and her clairvoyant mother must find a way to stop the evil. Horror, starring Shawn Ashmore and Ashley Greene.

programme.title: Anaconda
programme.desc: Film-makers venture deep into the Amazon jungle to document the lives of a remote tribe. However, the expedition is hijacked by a crazed hunter who plans to use them as bait to catch a gigantic killer snake. Adventure, starring Jennifer Lopez, Jon Voight, Ice Cube, Eric Stoltz and Jonathan Hyde.

programme.title: Final Destination: Bloodlines
programme.desc: Fifty-five years after her grandparents are involved in a disaster involving a restaurant tower, college student Stefani Reyes is plagued by recurring nightmares of the incident, and returns home seeking answers. The sixth entry in the supernatural horror saga, starring Kaitlyn Santa Juana, Teo Briones and Richard Harmon.

programme.title: Zombieland
programme.desc: A mutated virus sweeps across America, turning most of the population into hideous flesh-eating zombies. A hard-drinking fearless adventurer leads a small band of young survivors on a perilous journey through the wasteland in search of a safe haven. Comedy horror, with Woody Harrelson, Jesse Eisenberg, Emma Stone and Abigail Breslin.

programme.title: Zombieland: Double Tap
programme.desc: A decade after they joined forces, survivors Tallahassee, Columbus, Wichita and Little Rock have become experts in identifying and disposing assorted zombies. They set up their new home in the abandoned White House, but after Little Rock heads to Graceland, the team attempts to save her from a group of super zombies. Director Ruben Fleischer's comedy horror sequel, starring Woody Harrelson, Jesse Eisenberg and Emma Stone.

programme.title: Shaun of the Dead
programme.desc: An unambitious 29-year-old man recently dumped and trapped in the job from hell decides to get his life back on track. Unfortunately, he has to put his plans on hold when zombies rise from their graves and stalk the streets of London to feast on the living. Comedy horror, starring Simon Pegg, Nick Frost, Kate Ashfield, Dylan Moran, Lucy Davis, Bill Nighy and Penelope Wilton.

programme.title: Black Phone 2
programme.desc: Four years after a serial killer prowled the streets of North Denver, posing as a magician to lure unsuspecting children into the back of his van, teenager Finney tries to adjust to a normal life. However, the lethal Grabber returns, and is bent on revenge. Horror thriller, starring Ethan Hawke and Mason Thames.

programme.title: Evil Dead
programme.desc: Five friends travel to a remote woodland cabin, hoping one of them can conquer her drug addiction by going cold turkey. They uncover a mysterious book that, when read, unleashes demonic forces that possess the living and transform them into bloodthirsty zombies. Horror remake, starring Jane Levy and Shiloh Fernandez.

programme.title: Woman on the Run
programme.desc: After witnessing a murder, Frank Johnson goes on the run to avoid being killed himself. His wife, Eleanor (Ann Sheridan), seems almost apathetic about finding him when questioned by Investigator Harris (Robert Keith), due to a marriage on the rocks. However, after learning that Frank has a grave heart condition, Eleanor recruits reporter Dan Leggett (Dennis O'Keefe) to help track down Frank. Discovering new love for her husband along the way, Eleanor must get to Frank before the killer does.

programme.title: The Bigamist
programme.desc: San Francisco businessman Harry Graham (Edmond O'Brien) and his wife and business partner, Eve (Joan Fontaine), are in the process of adopting a child. When private investigator Jordan (Edmund Gwenn) uncovers the fact that Graham has another wife, Phyllis (Ida Lupino), and a small child in Los Angeles, he confesses everything. In flashback, Graham tells of the strains in his marriage with Eve and how he found himself falling for the kind-hearted waitress Phyllis while on a business trip.

programme.title: Woman on the Run
programme.desc: After witnessing a murder, Frank Johnson goes on the run to avoid being killed himself. His wife, Eleanor (Ann Sheridan), seems almost apathetic about finding him when questioned by Investigator Harris (Robert Keith), due to a marriage on the rocks. However, after learning that Frank has a grave heart condition, Eleanor recruits reporter Dan Leggett (Dennis O'Keefe) to help track down Frank. Discovering new love for her husband along the way, Eleanor must get to Frank before the killer does.

programme.title: The Bigamist
programme.desc: San Francisco businessman Harry Graham (Edmond O'Brien) and his wife and business partner, Eve (Joan Fontaine), are in the process of adopting a child. When private investigator Jordan (Edmund Gwenn) uncovers the fact that Graham has another wife, Phyllis (Ida Lupino), and a small child in Los Angeles, he confesses everything. In flashback, Graham tells of the strains in his marriage with Eve and how he found himself falling for the kind-hearted waitress Phyllis while on a business trip.

programme.title: What Would You Do?
programme.desc: Using hidden cameras, host John Quiñones observes and comments on how ordinary people behave when they are confronted with dilemmas that require them either to take action or to walk by and mind their own business. Various scenarios are created that force people to make split-second -- and often surprising -- decisions, and variations of the situation (such as changing the genders, races or clothing of the people involved) are often featured to see if different reactions are elicited. Examples of situations on the show include a waitress being harassed by her boss, and a drunken valet trying to park cars.

Recurring segments include the FCC-pleasing This Week in Unnecessary Censorship in which they take TV clips and "bleep and blur things whether they need it or not," as Kimmel describes it. programme.title: What Would You Do?
programme.desc: Using hidden cameras, host John Quiñones observes and comments on how ordinary people behave when they are confronted with dilemmas that require them either to take action or to walk by and mind their own business. Various scenarios are created that force people to make split-second -- and often surprising -- decisions, and variations of the situation (such as changing the genders, races or clothing of the people involved) are often featured to see if different reactions are elicited. Examples of situations on the show include a waitress being harassed by her boss, and a drunken valet trying to park cars.

programme.title: CBS News Sunday Morning
programme.desc: The sparkling notes of a trumpet fanfare and the familiar logo of the sun alert viewers that it's time for CBS's Sunday morning staple. Journalist Jane Pauley helms the show, taking over hosting duties from Charles Osgood, who spent 22 years on the job. A morning talk show, this program airs at a different pace and focuses much of its attention on the performing arts. After a quick update of the day's news and national weather, correspondents offer longer-length segments on a variety of topics, from architecture to ballet to music to pop culture to politics.

programme.title: The Price Is Right
programme.desc: "Come on down!" "The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." The two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. A trio of models presents the prizes.

programme.title: Card Sharks
programme.desc: This show from legendary Mark Goodson-Bill Todman Productions features two contestants trying to predict answers to survey questions for the opportunity to play a game with oversized playing cards for a chance to win cash. One contestant guesses how many people (out of 100) gave a certain answer to a question and the other contestant then guesses if the number is higher or lower than the opponent's guess. The winning contestant then faces a row of cards and must determine if each succeeding card is higher or lower than the one that precedes it. The contestant who wins two out of three games wins the match and plays the bonus round, called Money Cards. The Money Cards round is similar to the card game in the main game but with three levels of cards instead of one row. The contestant is given $200 at the beginning of Money Cards and wagers any or all of that money when guessing if the cards will be higher or lower than the previous one. A perfect round could earn the contestant $28,800.

programme.title: The Price Is Right
programme.desc: "Come on down!" "The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." The two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. A trio of models presents the prizes.

The contestant is given $200 at the beginning of Money Cards and wagers any or all of that money when guessing if the cards will be higher or lower than the previous one. A perfect round could earn the contestant $28,800.

programme.title: CBS News Sunday Morning
programme.desc: The sparkling notes of a trumpet fanfare and the familiar logo of the sun alert viewers that it's time for CBS's Sunday morning staple. Journalist Jane Pauley helms the show, taking over hosting duties from Charles Osgood, who spent 22 years on the job. A morning talk show, this program airs at a different pace and focuses much of its attention on the performing arts. After a quick update of the day's news and national weather, correspondents offer longer-length segments on a variety of topics, from architecture to ballet to music to pop culture to politics.

programme.title: Hot Bench
programme.desc: Many popular court shows are on TV. How can the genre improve? How about using a three-judge panel? That's the concept of "Hot Bench," created by Judge Judy Sheindlin. The jurists are experienced civil litigator Tanya Acker, New York State Supreme Court Justice Patricia DiMango, and former criminal defense attorney Larry Bakman. The show's title comes from a term describing a court action in which a judge frequently interrupts lawyers with questions.

programme.title: Walking with Monsters: Life Before Dinosaurs
programme.desc: Part 2/3. As the environment recovered, populations of one species of tough reptile exploded until it alone dominated the planet, but its reign was short-lived.

programme.title: Walking with Monsters: Life Before Dinosaurs

As the swamps dry up, the world becomes dominated by the first ever giant reptiles - the huge, sail-backed Edaphosaurus.

programme.title: Tutankhamun: Life, Death and Legacy

programme.title: Truth for Life
programme.desc: In The True Identity, Dr. Mark Sandoval explains how freedom, love, and stability flow from understanding who we truly are. Humanity’s fallen nature assumes the role of god—self-owned, self-sustaining, and self-defending—while God’s original design identifies us as His children: dependent, secure, and free. This episode shows what it looks like to live that identity in practical relationships, parenting, marriage, loss, injustice, and suffering. Using vivid illustrations, Dr. Sandoval demonstrates how having God as our only source frees us from manipulation, fear, control, and taking life personally. He contrasts stewardship with ownership, revealing why loss only devastates when we believe something belonged to us. The message also reframes suffering as a “talent” God uses to extend comfort and redemption to others. By grounding identity in God’s character and love, this presentation offers a pathway to contentment, resilience, and unselfish love that remains steady regardless of circumstances.

programme.title: Spotless
programme.desc: In Episode 7 of SPOTLESS, Shelley Quinn takes us through the rest of the biblical account of the great patriarchs of Genesis. Your eyes will be opened to understand why Abraham (and the strapping young Isaac) had the faith to submit to God’s strange request of human sacrifice that was purely a test of loyalty. Follow the twists and turns of the dramatic life accounts of Isaac, Jacob, and Joseph, and see how God’s gracious intervention helped them endure hardships, and brought them into covenant relationship with Him so that they could inherit His blessings. The lives of the patriarchs reverberate with lessons for our generation.

programme.title: Life After Choice
programme.desc: Before she married a pastor, Loretta Mix had two abortions—one before she became a Christian, and another afterwards. The impact of the second was devastating, and haunted her for over 30 years. Keeping her earlier choices a secret affected her as a wife and a mother, and robbed her of the joy of Christianity. When she finally spilled her secret to her husband, he told her to quit believing Satan’s lies. God’s love and His promises were for her. Loretta retrained her brain with God’s truths. Addressing a large group of women at a church event, God unexpectedly impressed her to share her testimony publicly, and the last yoke of bondage was broken.

programme.title: The Ultimate Encounter
programme.desc: In this transformative episode, we delve into the life-changing power of forgiveness and how it shapes our spiritual journey. Discover how the most influential person in your life might be the one you struggle to forgive. Through the teachings of Christ, we learn that forgiveness is not just a gift we offer others but a personal freedom we embrace ourselves. Explore the reciprocal nature of forgiveness, its divine mandate, and the evidence of Christ’s presence when we choose to forgive. As we journey from forgiveness to reconciliation, this episode highlights the importance of mending relationships and living in peace.

programme.title: Awesome Science
programme.desc: Noah explores Dinosaur National Monument in western Colorado. He’ll explore this amazing site, where hundreds of dinosaur skeletons have been found in a mass graveyard. He’ll take a look at the evidence for the Biblical record of dinosaurs living in recent history and why meteorites just don’t make sense for their demise. He’ll share how the global flood makes much more sense of how they met their end, as well as how they came off the ark and survived for a while after the Flood.

programme.title: The Creation Case
programme.desc: A great question has come in and HQ needs Rich to investigate. Why are there so many dead plants and animals found buried around the world? programme.title: 3ABN Hoy
programme.sub-title: Testimonio personal del Pr. José Feliciano Castillo Lugo
programme.desc: En esta inspiradora entrevista, el Pastor José Feliciano Castillo Lugo comparte profundamente su testimonio personal. Inicia relatando su infancia en Castaños, Coahuila (México), marcada por el alcoholismo de su padre. Sin embargo, tras “un último trago”, su padre decidió darle una oportunidad a Cristo. Este paso lo llevó a la Iglesia Adventista del Séptimo Día local, donde se bautizó y experimentó una transformación total, convirtiéndose en un ejemplo de rectitud para su familia. El Pr. Castillo continúa narrando su etapa como universitario, un periodo lleno de adversidades, frustraciones y desafíos. A pesar de ello, afirma que Dios lo sostuvo y lo ayudó a superar cada obstáculo. En ese proceso, Dios le mostró los “caminos torcidos” en los que viví a, y él tomó la decisión de enderezar sus pasos para honrar a Dios. Esta experiencia de cambio lo llevó finalmente al ministerio. Después de servir como oficial en México, hoy es evangelista y pastor en el estado de Tennessee, donde continúa compartiendo el mensaje de esperanza. Está casado con KeSardis, quien lo acompaña en el ministerio, y juntos crían a sus tres hijas. La entrevista es un testimonio poderoso de cómo Dios transforma vidas y abre nuevos comienzos. Para más historias de transformación y una amplia programación cristiana, puede descargar gratuitamente la aplicación 3ABN+ y suscribirse al canal 3ABN Latino en YouTube.

This reality series shows what happens when the performer hits the streets of London to showcase his close-up magic and stunts for unsuspecting locals and tourists. Von Scheibner takes advantage of his surroundings by drawing inspiration from the city's landmarks while integrating them into some of his illusions, such as teleporting across Tower Bridge. Some of Troy's tricks are more restrained, though, like when he uses his talents to help passengers get off of a bus.

programme.desc: "So whether you eat or drink, or whatever you do, do it all for the glory of God." (1 Corinthians 10:31) How can we use food to glorify God? programme.title: Matthew 24
programme.desc: Among all the prophecies of the Bible, Matthew 24 is unique because it presents end time events in the precise order in which they will occur. Thus, Matthew 24 serves as a blueprint for the study of Bible prophecy. This chapter (along with the parallel chapters in Mark 13 and Luke 21) describes events such as the little time of trouble, the latter rain, the loud cry, the universal Sunday law, the great tribulation, Satan’s counterfeit second coming, the sign of the Son of Man and the gathering of the elect. Don’t miss out on this important series.

How far has it penetrated the church today? Is it the “omega of apostasy” Ellen White warned us about? This series presents what could be the undermining of the movement raised to correct the errors of modern Protestantism. If the issues raised are indeed happening, then those committed to the historic teachings of the faith have no choice but to “Meet It!”.

programme.sub-title: S1 - Geneva: International Hub of Reform
programme.desc: This series is designed to remind us of our lineage - what has come before that shaped us into who we are today. These riveting videos combine tightly scripted history lessons with breathtaking footage of actual Reformation sites to bring to life the realities of our Christian heritage. This series will inspire you with the sacrifices of our spiritual predecessors along with the providences of God in preserving His people and the freedoms we enjoy today. You will be motivated as never before to deepen your concecration to God and to finish His work on earth!

programme.title: Belt of Truth - The Media Mind
programme.desc: In today's world a huge percentage of the population has developed a media addiction in some form or another. With social media, video games and television, there seems to be no end to the media content we can consume. But what are the negative affects of this overuse? How can we fight against the media attacks on our communities.. families.. our humanity? In this series, Scott Ritsema will discuss the spiritual controversy behind media and how we can filter out the dangers.

programme.title: White Horse Media - The Trinity Controversy
programme.desc: Debates about the Godhead rage on. What does the Bible really say about the Father, the Son, and the Holy Spirit? Are they three separate, equal, co-eternal Persons united in one, or only two (the Father and the Son), with the Father being the “true God,” and the Holy Spirit being an invisible manifestation of the Son? In this 5-part series, Steve Wohlberg and Kim Kjaer tackle this issue head on.

At these Christian boarding schools the refugees enjoy better living conditions, quality education, and an opportunity to learn more about God and His loving plan for them. Through this opportunity they can graduate with career eligibility and move their families out of the refugee camps for good!

programme.title: Walk of Shame
programme.desc: A woman's dream of becoming a news anchor is jeopardized by an ill-advised tryst that leaves her stranded in downtown Los Angeles with no money or transportation and only eight hours to make it to the most important job interview of her life.","large":"Meghan (Elizabeth Banks) is an aspiring news anchor in the cutthroat world of Los Angeles television. After an audition for her dream job ends in failure, she goes out for an uncharacteristic night of partying. The next morning, she awakes in a stranger's bed and hears a phone message from her agent telling her the job is hers if she can make it across town by 5:00 pm. Stranded in an unknown area without money, phone or transportation, she races to the most important interview of her life.

programme.title: Trainwreck
programme.desc: A promiscuous magazine writer considers monogamy for the first time when she starts to fall in love with the charming sports doctor she's profiling.","large":"Ever since her father drilled into her head that monogamy isn't realistic, magazine writer Amy has made promiscuity her credo. As much as she enjoys an uninhibited life free of commitment, Amy is really in a rut. While writing a profile about charming and successful sports doctor Aaron Conners, she finds herself actually falling in love for the first time, and what's more, Aaron seems to like her too. Amy starts to wonder if it's time to clean up her act.

programme.title: The Five-Year Engagement
programme.desc: Career plans and other obstacles stand in the way of two lovers (Jason Segel, Emily Blunt) who run into trouble each time they try to set a wedding date.","large":"On their one-year anniversary, sous chef Tom Solomon (Jason Segel) plans to surprise his girlfriend, Violet Barnes (Emily Blunt), with an engagement ring. The lovers do end up engaged, but the fact that the proposal does not go exactly as planned proves to be a harbinger of things to come. Each time they try to set a date, various obstacles stand in their way. As more and more time passes, Tom and Violet begin to wonder if perhaps their marriage is not meant to be.

programme.title: Chinese Zodiac
programme.desc: A treasure hunter (Jackie Chan) and his team set out on a global quest to find a set of Chinese zodiac bronze heads that were stolen from a Beijing palace in the 19th century.

programme.title: Trespass
programme.desc: Two Arkansas firefighters (Bill Paxton, William Sadler) have a shootout over gold with a crime lord's (Ice-T) gang in a factory.","large":"Firefighters Vince (Bill Paxton) and Don (William Sadler) venture into gang-infested territory to find gold that's been hidden inside an abandoned building. But when they witness a murder, they become the targets of crime lord King James (Ice-T) and his underling Savon (Ice Cube). Fortunately, the treasure hunters have kidnapped a bargaining chip: King James' half-brother, Lucky (Devoreaux White). But this might not be enough to get them -- and their gold -- out of the building intact.

programme.title: Smokin' Aces
programme.desc: Two FBI agents (Ray Liotta, Ryan Reynolds) must protect an entertainer (Jeremy Piven) from a motley crew of assassins after the guy agrees to testify against the Las Vegas mob.","large":"Sleazy entertainer Buddy "Aces" Israel incurs the wrath of crime boss Primo Sparazza when he agrees to testify against the Las Vegas mob. Two FBI agents have the difficult task of protecting him from a motley assortment of bounty hunters, hit men and nefarious vixens who are converging on his Lake Tahoe encampment to rub him out and collect a hefty reward.

programme.title: They Live
programme.desc: When two men (Roddy Piper, Keith David) put on special sunglasses they see aliens and subliminal messages.","large":"Nada (Roddy Piper), a wanderer without meaning in his life, discovers a pair of sunglasses capable of showing the world the way it truly is. As he walks the streets of Los Angeles, Nada notices that both the media and the government are comprised of subliminal messages meant to keep the population subdued, and that most of the social elite are skull-faced aliens bent on world domination. With this shocking discovery, Nada fights to free humanity from the mind-controlling aliens.

programme.title: The Watcher
programme.desc: A traumatized FBI agent (James Spader) comes out of hiding to catch a serial killer (Keanu Reeves) who sends him pictures of his intended victims before he strikes.","large":"The Watcher is an exciting psychological thriller that takes a unique look into the minds of both a serial killer and the man who must, reluctantly, pursue him. In an almost Hitchcockian way, the film quickly introduces us to the killer, David Allen Griffin, played by Keanu Reeves, who for many years, preyed on lonely young women in the Los Angeles area. The story is set up to create a taut cat-and-mouse game between Griffin and FBI agent Joel Campbell.

programme.title: Captive State
programme.desc: Gabriel is a young man who joins a resistance group that's fighting back against extraterrestrial occupation of Chicago. He soon finds himself under careful scrutiny from a shadowy figure who's trying to crush the rebellion and its plans for freedom.","large":"After 10 years of extraterrestrial occupation, residents of Chicago must decide whether to continue to live under alien rule or support the resistance. When young Gabriel Drummond joins the insurgency, he soon finds himself under careful scrutiny from a shadowy figure who's trying to crush the rebellion and its plans for freedom.

programme.title: The Fourth Kind
programme.desc: During videotaped sessions with her patients, a psychologist (Milla Jovovich) in Alaska uncovers disturbing evidence of alien abductions.","large":"Since the 1960s, a disproportionate number of the population in and around Nome, Alaska, have gone missing. Despite FBI investigations, the disappearances remain a mystery. Dr. Abigail Tyler (Milla Jovovich), a psychologist, may be on the verge of blowing the unsolved cases wide open when, during the course of treating her patients, she finds evidence of alien abductions.

programme.title: Lone Survivor
programme.desc: In the mountains of Afghanistan, a squad of Taliban fighters ambushes four Navy SEALs, who are there on a mission to eliminate a high-ranking al-Qaeda operative.","large":"In 2005 Afghanistan, Navy SEALs Marcus Luttrell (Mark Wahlberg), Michael Murphy (Taylor Kitsch), Danny Dietz (Emile Hirsch) and Matthew "Axe" Axelson (Ben Foster) deploy on a mission of surveillance and to take out Taliban leader Ahmad Shah. Though spotted by goatherds, Luttrell and his team decide not to kill them. But one of the Afghans alerts a group of Taliban fighters to the invaders, and a terrible battle ensues, in which the SEALs find themselves hopelessly outnumbered and outgunned.

programme.title: Jarhead 2: Field of Fire
programme.desc: Without tanks or air support, a corporal and his team must muster all the courage and firepower they can to fight their way across war-torn Afghanistan and shepherd an important anti-Taliban woman to safety.

programme.title: Walk of Shame
programme.desc: A woman's dream of becoming a news anchor is jeopardized by an ill-advised tryst that leaves her stranded in downtown Los Angeles with no money or transportation and only eight hours to make it to the most important job interview of her life.","large":"Meghan (Elizabeth Banks) is an aspiring news anchor in the cutthroat world of Los Angeles television. After an audition for her dream job ends in failure, she goes out for an uncharacteristic night of partying. The next morning, she awakes in a stranger's bed and hears a phone message from her agent telling her the job is hers if she can make it across town by 5:00 pm. Stranded in an unknown area without money, phone or transportation, she races to the most important interview of her life.

programme.title: American Pie
programme.desc: Four teenage boys enter a pact to lose their virginity by prom night.

programme.title: Doomsday
programme.desc: A commander (Rhona Mitra) and her crew venture into long-quarantined Scotland to find the counteragent to a deadly virus that has re-emerged in London.","large":"When the first outbreak of the Reaper virus hit Scotland, Eden Sinclair was one of the last to escape containment and had to leave her mother behind. Twenty-five years later, Maj. Eden Sinclair (Rhona Mitra) leads a team back into the hot zone to find a counteragent to the virus, which has re-emerged in London. She and her comrades wage a desperate battle for survival against feral survivors, as they try to prevent it from ushering in a new dark age.

programme.title: The Purge: Anarchy
programme.desc: Three groups of people intertwine and are left stranded in the streets on Purge Night, trying to survive the chaos and violence that occurs.","large":"One night per year, the government sanctions a 12-hour period in which citizens can commit any crime they wish -- including murder -- without fear of punishment or imprisonment. Leo, a sergeant who lost his son, plans a vigilante mission of revenge during the mayhem. However, instead of a death-dealing avenger, he becomes the unexpected protector of four innocent strangers who desperately need his help if they are to survive the night.

programme.title: Dead Silence
programme.desc: After his wife meets a grisly end, a man (Ryan Kwanten) returns to their haunted hometown and uncovers a supernatural link to her death.","large":"After his wife meets a grisly end, Jamie Ashen (Ryan Kwanten) returns to their creepy hometown of Ravens Fair to unravel the mystery of her murder. Once there, he discovers the legend of Mary Shaw (Joan Heney), a murdered ventriloquist whose eerie presence still looms over the town. As he desperately digs for answers, Jamie encounters the curse that took his wife's life and threatens his own.

programme.title: The Hitcher
programme.desc: Two traveling students (Sophia Bush, Zachary Knighton) pick up a hitchhiker (Sean Bean), unaware that he is a serial killer who intends to pin his crimes on them.","large":"Grace and Jim are a pair of college students on their way to spring break in a 1970 Oldsmobile. Blissfully unaware of the horror that awaits them, they offer a ride to hitchhiker John Ryder, a killer who subsequently terrorizes the couple and implicates them in a grisly slaying.

programme.title: The Darkness
programme.desc: A supernatural force terrorizes a couple (Kevin Bacon, Radha Mitchell) and their two children after the young son brings home some mysterious rocks from the Grand Canyon.","large":"Peter Taylor (Kevin Bacon), his wife Bronny and their two children return to Los Angeles after a fun-filled vacation to the Grand Canyon. Strange events soon start to plague the family, including young son Michael's increasingly erratic behavior. The Taylors learn that Michael brought back some mysterious rocks that he discovered inside a cave. Unfortunately, something followed them home as the clan now find themselves in a battle with a supernatural force that preys on their worst fears.

programme.title: Unfriended
programme.desc: A teenager (Shelley Hennig) and her five friends (Moses Storm, Renee Olstead) become the prey of an unknown online presence that wants revenge for a shaming video that caused a classmate to kill herself one year prior.","large":"One night, while teenagers Blaire, Mitch, Jess, Adam Ken and Val take part in an online group chat session, they are suddenly joined by a user known only as "Billie227." Thinking it's just a technical glitch, the friends carry on their conversation... until Blaire begins receiving messages from someone claiming to be Laura Barns, a classmate who killed herself exactly one year prior. As Blaire tries to expose Billie's identity, her friends are forced to confront their darkest secrets and lies.

programme.title: Cry Wolf
programme.desc: Mysterious murders occur when students (Lindy Booth, Julian Morris) at a prep school invent a story about a serial killer.

programme.title: Children of Men
programme.desc: When infertility threatens mankind with extinction, a disillusioned bureaucrat becomes the unlikely champion in the fight for the survival of Earth's population.","large":"When infertility threatens mankind with extinction and the last child born has perished, a disillusioned bureaucrat (Clive Owen) becomes the unlikely champion in the fight for the survival of Earth's population; He must face down his own demons and protect the planet's last remaining hope from danger.

programme.title: Psycho
programme.desc: A woman (Anne Heche) steals cash at work, hits the road and stays at a desolate motel run by mad, mother-fixated Norman Bates (Vince Vaughn).","large":"Hoping for a fresh start with her broke boyfriend, Marion (Anne Heche) steals a huge sum from her boss and skips town, eventually stopping at a remote motel. There, she's served by the intensely awkward yet docile Norman Bates (Vince Vaughn), whom she often hears arguing with his domineering mother. But later that night, Marion is brutally slain, and Norman finds and hides the body. When a detective and Marion's sister visit the motel to investigate, they uncover shocking truths.

programme.title: Twelve Monkeys
programme.desc: A psychiatrist (Madeleine Stowe) finally believes a patient (Bruce Willis) who claims to be a time-traveler sent to 1996 to prevent a virulent holocaust.","large":"Traveling back in time isn't simple, as James Cole (Bruce Willis) learns the hard way. Imprisoned in the 2030s, James is recruited for a mission that will send him back to the 1990s. Once there, he's supposed to gather information about a nascent plague that's about to exterminate the vast majority of the world's population. But, aside from the manic Jeffrey (Brad Pitt), he gets little in the way of cooperation, not least from medical gatekeepers like Dr. Kathryn Railly (Madeleine Stowe).

programme.title: Altered
programme.desc: Fifteen years after they were abducted by aliens, four men get a chance to take revenge when they capture one of the creatures.","large":"Forever damaged by their stint as the scientific subjects of hostile alien creatures, a trio of alien-abduction survivors -- Otis (Michael C. Williams), Duke (Brad William Henke) and Cody (Paul McCarthy-Boyington) -- troll the wooded site of their disappearance, heavily armed, in search of their attackers. After wounding a violent alien in the woods, the three drag its dying body to the home of reclusive fellow abductee Wyatt (Adam Kaufman), barricade themselves in and prepare for the worst.

programme.title: The Forest
programme.desc: While investigating the disappearance of her twin sister, a young American encounters the tormented spirits of Japan's mysterious and legendary Aokigahara Forest.","large":"When her twin sister disappears in Japan, a young American named Sara becomes determined to find out what happened to her. Sara's investigation leads her to the legendary Aokigahara Forest, located at the base of Mount Fuji. Accompanied by expatriate Aiden, she enters the mysterious wilderness after being warned to "stay on the path." Her investigation plunges her into a dark world where the angry and tormented souls of the dead prey on those who dare to explore the forest.

programme.title: Land of the Dead
programme.desc: A mercenary leader (Simon Baker) squares off with a rebellious comrade (John Leguizamo), while flesh-eating zombies threaten their fortified city.","large":"In a world where zombies form the majority of the population, the remaining humans build a feudal society away from the undead. Ruthless Paul Kaufman (Dennis Hopper) rules and protects this microcosm but enforces painful class distinctions. Second-in-command Cholo DeMora (John Leguizamo) attempts to lead a secret rebellion against Kaufman's tyranny, but when the zombies begin to evolve, the survivors must discover a way to protect themselves from a zombie horde that can learn and adapt.

programme.title: Werewolf: The Beast Among Us
programme.desc: A mysterious creature terrorizes a village, and Daniel teams up with werewolf hunters to track down the vicious beast. As villagers are attacked one by one and, themselves, turned into beasts, Daniel fears the foe is someone close to them all.

programme.title: Tremors 4: The Legend Begins
programme.desc: A man (Michael Gross) hires a mercenary to destroy gigantic worms that are terrorizing a mining town in the 1800s.","large":"Prim East Coast dandy Hiram Gummer (Michael Gross) arrives in the town of Rejection, Nev., to investigate a series of strange deaths at the silver mine he owns. He receives help from local innkeeper Christine Lord (Sara Botsford) and miner Juan Pedilla (Brent Roam). But, when it turns out that gigantic killer worms that burrow underground are responsible for the miners' deaths, Hiram decides he'd better call in expert gunslinger Black Hand Kelly (Billy Drago) to save the day.

programme.title: Tremors 5: Bloodlines
programme.desc: Survivalist Burt Gummer (Michael Gross) and his new sidekick Travis (Jamie Kennedy) are hired to track down an ass-blaster terrorizing South Africa. As they engage in battles with the aggressive creatures, they discover an even more lethal creature.

programme.title: Tremors: Shrieker Island
programme.desc: Burt Gummer must save the day when a wealthy playboy unleashes a gigantic, carnivorous worm and other monsters on a tropical island.

programme.title: Serenity
programme.desc: Crew members (Nathan Fillion, Gina Torres, Alan Tudyk) aboard a transport vessel get caught in a deadly conflict in the wake of a galactic war.","large":"In this continuation of the television series "Firefly," a group of rebels travels the outskirts of space aboard their ship, Serenity, outside the reach of the Alliance, a sinister regime that controls most of the universe. After the crew takes in Simon (Sean Maher) and his psychic sister, River (Summer Glau), whom he has just rescued from Alliance forces, they find themselves being pursued by the Operative (Chiwetel Ejiofor), an Alliance agent who will stop at nothing to find them.

programme.title: Pitch Black
programme.desc: Passengers marooned on a remote planet soon learn that their only hope from the deadly creatures lurking in the dark is a dangerous escaped convict. Starring Vin Diesel and Radha Mitchell.","large":"When their ship crashes on an unexplored planet, the survivors of the crash soon discover that this planet that is normally always day is going to soon be in a state of eclipse that will bring out deadly nocturnal creatures. Will a prison convict (Vin Diesel) being transported on the ship end up being the one man who can lead the survivors off the planet?

programme.title: Oblivion
programme.desc: Two weeks before he is scheduled to depart from devastated planet Earth forever, a drone repairman rescues a woman from a downed spaceship, triggering a final battle to save mankind.","large":"In the year 2077, Jack Harper works as a security repairman on an Earth left empty and devastated after a war with aliens. Jack has two weeks left before his mission ends, and he joins his fellow survivors on a faraway colony. However, Jack's concept of reality comes crashing down after he rescues a beautiful stranger from a downed spacecraft. The woman's arrival triggers a chain of events that culminates in Jack's nearly single-handed battle to save mankind.

programme.title: The Mummy
programme.desc: An ancient Egyptian princess is awakened from her crypt beneath the desert, bringing with her malevolence grown over millennia, and terrors that defy human comprehension.","large":"Nick Morton is a soldier of fortune who plunders ancient sites for timeless artifacts and sells them to the highest bidder. When Nick and his partner come under attack in the Middle East, the ensuing battle accidentally unearths Ahmanet, a betrayed Egyptian princess who was entombed under the desert for thousands of years. With her powers constantly evolving, Morton must now stop the resurrected monster as she embarks on a furious rampage through the streets of London.

programme.title: Engine Masters
programme.desc: The guys find out if mandrel-bent exhaust pipes really make more power over the crimped and crunched pipes the local shop bends up.

programme.title: Engine Masters
programme.desc: The crew tests 10 different filters in a hunt for the best units available.

programme.title: Engine Masters
programme.desc: The guys test five carb hats and see how orientation affects performance.

programme.title: Engine Masters
programme.desc: The crew is searching for low air temps and big HP numbers as they compare the heat-extracting power of under-roots intercoolers vs. E85; they aim to bring up the entire curve by swapping the short-runner blower manifold for a tunnel ram.

programme.title: Engine Masters
programme.sub-title: Is Intake Manifold Port Matching Worth It?
programme.desc: The crew auditions their 406 SBC with an out-of-the-box Super Victor, a port-matched Super Victor and an off-shelf Wilson-prepped version.

programme.title: Engine Masters
programme.desc: Testing the headers, intake, fuel system and everything else that will be used in David Freiburger's Model A drag car.

programme.title: Engine Masters
programme.sub-title: 4150 v. 4500 - The Battle of the Holley Carbs
programme.desc: Holley carbs have been the standard by which all racing carbs are measured, but CFMs are equal; looking at the difference in power between the smaller-bore, narrower-set 4150 carb and the bigger-bore, wider-base 4500 Dominator.

programme.title: Engine Masters
programme.desc: The crew looks at compression and how it makes power plus how sensitive it becomes to temperature on pump gas.

programme.title: Engine Masters
programme.desc: It's a battle between the iconic 440 Six Pack and the legendary 426 Hemi.

programme.title: Engine Masters
programme.desc: The guys demonstrate how improved airflow on a small motor equals pure RPM.

programme.title: Engine Masters
programme.desc: The crew explains the difference between standard, high-volume and high-pressure oil pumps in terms of pressure, flow and horsepower.

programme.title: Engine Masters
programme.sub-title: Exhaust for Turbos - The Dos and Dont's
programme.desc: The crew tries to find the right balance of decibel levels and performance.

programme.title: Engine Masters
programme.desc: It's a battle of price vs. power for street-centric wedge cylinder heads.

programme.title: Engine Masters
programme.desc: The crew dives into the waters of individual runner systems, shows how to tune them, and whether all that cool makes any more power than the stalwart carburetor.

programme.title: Engine Masters
programme.sub-title: Choosing Fuel: Which Barrel Is Right for You?
programme.desc: The guys study the fueling demands, horsepower, and the pros and cons of running different types of fuel.

programme.title: Engine Masters
programme.sub-title: Water-Meth Injection: Is It Cooler Than the Intercooler??
programme.desc: The guys explore the cooling benefits of water-methanol injection.

programme.title: Engine Masters
programme.desc: The guys test air filter size, along with cold air system configuration.

programme.title: Engine Masters
programme.sub-title: Nitrous for Noobs - The 150 Shot Walkthrough
programme.desc: Using a basic 150-horse plate system, the crew demonstrates the basics on installation, safety and tuning for a typical carbureted engine.

programme.title: Engine Masters
programme.desc: We explore the differences between single and split-duration camshafts.

programme.title: Engine Masters
programme.desc: Testing intake upgrades for a street car swap; pitting the factory manifold against a worked-up aftermarket piece.

programme.title: Engine Masters
programme.sub-title: The Piston Pin Offset Flip -- Is It a Flop?
programme.desc: The guys perform what may be the first ever back-to-back comparison of factory-oriented pistons against reverse-oriented pistons.

programme.title: Engine Masters
programme.desc: The General Mayhem 440 is strapped on the dyno and decisions on which intake and headers to run, as well as how to squeeze out more than the 707 Hellcat horsepower, are made.

programme.title: Engine Masters
programme.sub-title: A Crash Course in Valve Float
programme.desc: Some know valve float as the evil that lurks beyond the redline, the dreaded robber of horsepower and destroyer of valves; taking a look at the valve float.

programme.title: Iron Resurrection
programme.desc: The team tears into a 1962 Chevy truck; Joe Martin plans to create a radical custom lowrider that scrapes the ground; improvements include a new air-ride suspension, tray, front end and paint job.

programme.title: Iron Resurrection
programme.desc: Joe has big plans for a 1964 Lincoln Continental, but a faulty steering column and a close call in the shop threaten to turn the flip into a never-ending money pit.

programme.title: Iron Resurrection
programme.desc: Joe and the gang turn a 1953 Ford Ranch Wagon into a mean beach cruiser; an accident occurs in the shop; the race is on to repaint a client's custom-built bike.

programme.title: Iron Resurrection
programme.desc: Joe and the team work on a 1973 Pontiac Firebird that was damaged by fire; a waterlogged engine puts the brakes on the build.

programme.title: Iron Resurrection
programme.desc: The team tackles a custom Softail from the ground up; Shag and Amanda discover a 1947 International milk truck in need of repair; a customer brings in a 1955 Chevy race car.

programme.title: Iron Resurrection
programme.desc: Joe believes that wide wheels and a killer paint job will attract customers to a 1964 Cadillac Coupe DeVille convertible, but hidden rust on the vehicle threatens to spoil his planned improvements.

programme.title: Iron Resurrection
programme.desc: Martin Bros. Customs prepares to transform a 1970 Chevy C10 into an autocross hot rod; Shag and Amanda desperately search for a sturdy cab for the build.

programme.title: Iron Resurrection
programme.desc: A 1935 Chevrolet Master rolls into the shop; made famous by the gangsters of its time, the vehicle features a distinctive grill, wood interior and "suicide doors.".

programme.title: Wilde Wege
programme.desc: Der Trans-Sulawesi Highway ist die Lebensader der viertgrößten Insel Indonesiens und verbindet verschiedene Orte. Traumhafte Strände, turbulente Großstädte oder tiefe Urwälder. Als Busfahrer auf dem Highway braucht man Know-how und starke Nerven.

programme.title: Wilde Wege
programme.desc: Im äußersten Nordosten Norwegens, der Finnmark, sind die Winter eiskalt und schneereich. Durch die Lage am Arktischen Ozean sind die Straßen anfällig für Schneeverwehungen. Jeder Meter ist eine Herausforderung und eine Fahrt ins Risiko.

programme.title: Adrenalinjunkies
programme.desc: Im Off-Road Park gelten andere Regeln als im Straßenverkehr. Die Sendung ist geeignet für Menschen, die schon als Kind vom Bagger fahren träumten. Auf einem riesigen Spielplatz werden Tatra-LKWs, Quads und Offroad-Trainer bewegt.

programme.title: Adrenalinjunkies
programme.desc: Die Vorstellung, vom Gleitschirm aus die atemberaubende Aussicht auf die Erde zu genießen, fasziniert viele. Fluglehrer Lukas Bader bringt seinen Schülern genau das bei, indem er sie in der notwendigen Theorie für einen Flugschein unterrichtet.

programme.title: Epic Exploring: Going Local
programme.desc: Josh Yozura begibt sich diesmal nach Zypern. Von Nikosia aus reist er quer durch das Land zu einem verlassenen Vergnügungspark. Außerdem besucht er ein ehemaliges Asbestbergwerk und ein Schiffswrack, das sich vor der Küste befindet.

programme.title: Epic Exploring: Going Local
programme.desc: Diesmal ist Cody Buffinton gemeinsam mit Lexi Limitless in New Orleans unterwegs. Gemeinsam erkunden die beiden zunächst ein verlassenes Spital in der Stadt in Louisiana. Anschließend trifft Cody noch auf Brutus, einen Riesenalligator.

programme.title: Epic Exploring: Going Local
programme.desc: Josh ist in der ehemaligen Sowjetrepublik Armenien unterwegs und besucht die Hauptstadt Jerewan. Er hat vor, dort einige der längst verlassenen, aber noch immer faszinierenden Gebäude aus der Zeit der Sowjetbesatzung zu besuchen.

programme.title: Epic Exploring: Going Local
programme.desc: Josh Yozura kehrt nach Gary im Nordwesten des Bundesstaates Indiana zurück, um sich zu Hause einmal genauer umzusehen. Er und seine Freunde erkunden gemeinsam ein ehemaliges Bankgebäude, das Auditorium und den Bahnhof Union Train Station.

programme.title: Epic Exploring: Going Local
programme.desc: Cody besucht Zagreb, die im Nordwesten gelegene Hauptstadt des Landes Kroatien. Dort feuert er eine Kanone aus dem alten Turm ab und erkundet ein nie fertig gestelltes Universitätskrankenhaus. Außerdem besucht er eine politische Schule.

programme.title: Auto Motor Party
programme.desc: Einmal jährlich versammeln sich am Flugplatz Eisenach deutsche Motorfreaks zu den "German-RaceWars". Es ist eines der größten Outdoor-Events des Landes und ambitionierte Hobby-Rennfahrer testen auf der Strecke ihr Können.

programme.title: Auto Motor Party
programme.desc: Einmal im Jahr wird Oschersleben zum Mekka der Opel-Fans. 2019 kamen mehr als 50.000 auf Deutschlands nördlichste Rennstrecke und verwandelten die Motorsport-Arena in eine Partymeile. Das weltweit größte Treffen seiner Art zieht alle an.

programme.title: Auto Motor Party
programme.desc: Alljährlich gibt es zu Pfingsten ein ganz besonderes Fest: Wild Wild East - das Highlight für VW- und Audi-Enthusiasten aus ganz Europa. Zum fünfundzwanzigsten Jubiläum des Events reisen gut 20.000 Fans nach Sachsen. Die Teilnahme ist legendär.

programme.title: Re:
programme.desc: In ganz Europa fehlen Busfahrer. Über 100.000 Stellen sind unbesetzt. Durch den Personalmangel häufen sich Ausfälle oder Verspätungen. Doch der europäische Markt an Busfahrern ist wie leergefegt. Ein neuer Ansatz könnten Busfahrer aus Indien sein.

programme.title: Die Kultschrauber
programme.desc: In Tom's Roadhouse bekommt ein Oldie-VW-Bus aus Arizona eine Frischzellenkur, während bei Lundtauto in Berlin ein Porsche 911 aus den 1970er-Jahren auf eine Komplettrestaurierung wartet. In Hamburg kommen nur britische Originale auf die Hebebühne.

programme.title: Die Kultschrauber
programme.desc: Die Schrauber der Minis Hamburg lassen die Flex kreisen, um Rost von Minis zu entfernen. Porsche-Spezialist Thomas Lundt hat sich der anspruchsvollen Restaurierung von Oldtimern verschrieben, während in Hamburg eine Vespa aufgebaut wird.

programme.title: Die Kultschrauber
programme.desc: In Tom's Roadhouse bekommt der T1-Oldie neue Safari-Fenster, während bei den Roller-Profis der Flying Classics heute eine Ausfahrt ansteht. Motor-Spezialist Michi von den Minis Hamburg setzt bei der Getriebereparatur nicht nur auf seine Erfahrung.

programme.title: Die Kultschrauber
programme.desc: Die frisch lackierte Porsche-Karosse wartet bei Lundt in Berlin auf das Motorfinish, während Manni von den Minis Hamburg eine durchgerostete Tür wieder auf Vordermann bringt. In der Roller-Werkstatt der Flying Classics ist Abschied angesagt.

programme.title: Blindspots - Blind um die Welt
programme.desc: James und sein älterer Bruder Colton fahren nach Austin, Texas, um BBQ von einem blinden Grillmeister und Live-Musik von einem blinden Musiker zu genießen. Ein kurzer Roadtrip nach Houston bringt sie mit der blinden Starköchin Christine Ha zusammen.

programme.title: Blindspots - Blind um die Welt
programme.desc: Die Reisereportage begleitet blinde Menschen auf ihren Abenteuern. In der siebten Folge der ersten Staffel werden die Sinne der Protagonisten an ungewöhnlichen Orten gefordert, während sie kulturelle sowie landschaftliche Highlights erleben.

programme.title: Blindspots - Blind um die Welt
programme.desc: Der blinde Regisseur James Rath bereist Metropolen, um zu zeigen, dass dies auch für eingeschränkte Personen möglich ist - wenn es mit der Barrierefreiheit ernst genommen wird. Er und Cassie besuchen diesmal die "ETH Zürich".

programme.title: Blindspots - Blind um die Welt
programme.desc: In Tokio versucht James, sich nicht in der Menge zu verlieren. Er will zudem seine Angst vor Meeresfrüchten überwinden. Er trifft einen blinden Breakdancer und erfährt, wie Sehende und Blinde sich auf die nächste Naturkatastrophe vorbereiten.

programme.title: Blindspots - Blind um die Welt
programme.desc: Der Hochgeschwindigkeitszug bringt James nach Osaka und seinem Ziel näher: dem Aufstieg auf den Fuji. Abseits großer Städte sucht James in den Tempeln von Kyoto nach Frieden. Heilige Traditionen bieten ihm eine neue Perspektive auf das Leben.

programme.title: Faszination Rollenspiel
programme.desc: Den Neusser Krieg von 1475 inszenieren hunderte europäische Spätmittelalter-Rollenspieler wieder. In der Stadt Zons am Rhein stehen kostümierte Männer mit Schwertern und Lanzen, um diese historische Schlacht wieder auf zu erleben.

programme.title: Faszination Rollenspiel
programme.desc: Die Frightguys sind Fans von Grauen und Grusel - oder kurz dem Horror-Genre. Sie leben mit ihren selbst gemachten Kostümen auf Conventions und Szene-Treffen ihre schönsten Albträume aus, um in die Rollen ihrer schauderhaften Figuren zu schlüpfen.

programme.desc: In einem Wald bei Kaiserslautern liegt das einzige Shaolin-Kloster Europas, das Kampfmönche ausbildet. Novizen und Meister trainieren hier bis zu acht Stunden täglich. Ziel sind körperliche Grenzerfahrungen und die Befreiung des Geistes.

programme.title: Welt der Zukunft

programme.title: Re:
programme.sub-title: Bandenkriminalität in Schweden - Eskalation der Gewalt
programme.desc: Während in ganz Europa die Gewaltkriminalität sinkt, steigt in Schweden die Waffengewalt. 124 Menschen kamen im Jahr 2020 durch Schusswaffen zu Tode. Es handelt sich dabei eher um unorganisierte, nicht um organisierte Kriminalität.

programme.title: Re:
programme.desc: Schweden hat seit Jahren ein Problem mit der Bandenkriminalität. Jeden Monat sterben dort mehr Menschen durch Schusswaffen als in anderen europäischen Ländern. Schießereien und Bombenanschläge erschüttern das Land. Die Täter werden immer jünger.

programme.title: Beeindruckende Spürnasen
programme.desc: Hunde haben einen ausgeprägten Geruchssinn, der ihnen hilft, den Menschen in vielen Bereichen zu unterstützen. Studien zeigen nun, das sie neben dem Erschnüffeln von Sprengstoffen und vermissten Personen auch Krankheiten erkennen können.

programme.title: Titans of Defense
programme.desc: Wenn das Militär Unterstützung im Einsatz benötigt, greift es auf Militärmaschinen zurück, die für die unterschiedlichsten Zwecke entwickelt wurden: von der Lieferung von Nachschub an das Schlachtfeld bis hin zur Bergung von Militärfahrzeugen.

programme.title: Titans of Defense
programme.desc: Das Zeitalter der Drohnenkriegsführung und der autonomen Verteidigung ist angebrochen, und zur Durchführung von Fernoperationen setzen Drohnen, Raketen und Verteidigungssysteme bahnbrechende Sensoren, Algorithmen und Kontrollzentren ein.

programme.title: Geniale Mega-Maschinen
programme.desc: Die Sendung beschäftigt sich mit kolossalen Maschinen, die ungeahnte Möglichkeiten eröffnen, um die tief in der Erde verbogenen Schätze zu bergen. Sie ermöglichen den Zugang zu Materialien, die die Infrastruktur und Technologien vorantreiben.

programme.title: Die große Algen-Invasion
programme.desc: Gigantische Algenteppiche breiten sich unaufhaltsam an den Küsten aus und bedrohen maritime Ökosysteme sowie den lokalen Tourismus. Forscher und Anwohner kämpfen gemeinsam gegen die grüne Flut, um das Gleichgewicht im Meer rasch wiederherzustellen.

programme.title: Reefs of Hope - Die Korallenretter
programme.desc: Weltweit beobachten Wissenschaftler, wie Korallenriffe durch die Erderwärmung stark bedroht sind. Die Wissenschaft versucht deshalb mit neuen Technologien das Absterben zu stoppen und eine Regeneration der Korallenriffe einzuleiten.

programme.title: Twilight-Zone im Ozean
programme.desc: Die Dokumentation begleitet ein Team von Forschern in die mittleren Tiefen des Meeres. Dort gibt es eine Welt voller flimmernder und blinkender Kreaturen. In der "Twilight Zone" der Ozeane warten noch viele verborgene Schätze.

programme.title: Das Wesen der Wale
programme.desc: Wale sind beeindruckend clevere Tiere. Der Regisseur und Biologe Rick Rosenthal taucht mit Walen und erklärt anhand jüngster wissenschaftlicher Erkenntnisse die überraschenden kognitiven Fähigkeiten der riesigen Meeressäuger.

programme.title: Pelagos - Welt der Wale
programme.desc: Der Film zeigt das Leben der Wale und Delfine im Pelagos-Schutzgebiet, das im Mittelmeer liegt.

programme.title: Rettet den Glattwal
programme.desc: Weltweit gibt es geschätzt nur noch 200 bis 250 Exemplare des Nordatlantischen Glattwals. Die meisten Tiere sterben oder verletzen sich durch Zusammenstöße mit Schiffen oder weil sie sich in den Fischernetzen verheddern.

programme.title: Raumsonden - Eroberer des Sonnensystems
programme.desc: Als innere Planeten bezeichnet man die vier Gesteinsplaneten Merkur, Venus, Erde und Mars. Sie zeichnen sich durch eine feste, felsige Oberfläche, eine hohe Dichte, geringere Größe und ihre Position innerhalb des Asteroidengürtels aus.

programme.title: Raumsonden - Eroberer des Sonnensystems
programme.desc: Die Raumsonden Voyager 1 und 2 erkunden seit 1977 die äußeren Planeten unseres Sonnensystems. Begleiten Sie spannende Missionen ins All und erfahren Sie, welche neuen Erkenntnisse spätere Flugkörper über diese Welten gewinnen konnten.

programme.title: Breakthrough
programme.desc: Die Sendung befasst sich mit dem Spitzer-Weltraumteleskop. Es macht eine bahnbrechende Entdeckung von Exoplaneten, die der Erde ähnlich sein könnten. Damit könnte die NASA neue Rückschlüsse über das Leben im Universum liefern.

programme.title: Die Geburt des Sonnensystems
programme.desc: Das Sonnensystem ist nach dem Urknall aus dem Chaos entstanden. Die Planeten haben sich um die Sonne gebildet, einige sind in sie hinein gestürzt, andere sind für immer ins All geschleudert worden. So begann ein Kampf ums Überleben im Weltraum.

programme.title: Re:
programme.sub-title: Meine Katze aus Damaskus - Wie Geflüchtete ihre Haustiere wiedersehen
programme.desc: Mehr als eine Million Menschen sind auf der Flucht vor dem Bürgerkrieg in Syrien in Europa untergekommen. Viele haben auch ihr Haustier zurückgelassen. Eine geflüchtete Syrerin hilft ihren Landsleuten bei der Wiedervereinigung mit ihren Vierbeinern.

programme.title: Epic Exploring: Going Local
programme.desc: Diesmal ist Cody Buffinton gemeinsam mit Lexi Limitless in New Orleans unterwegs. Gemeinsam erkunden die beiden zunächst ein verlassenes Spital in der Stadt in Louisiana. Anschließend trifft Cody noch auf Brutus, einen Riesenalligator.

programme.title: Epic Exploring: Going Local
programme.desc: Josh ist in der ehemaligen Sowjetrepublik Armenien unterwegs und besucht die Hauptstadt Jerewan. Er hat vor, dort einige der längst verlassenen, aber noch immer faszinierenden Gebäude aus der Zeit der Sowjetbesatzung zu besuchen.

programme.title: Epic Exploring: Going Local
programme.desc: Josh Yozura kehrt nach Gary im Nordwesten des Bundesstaates Indiana zurück, um sich zu Hause einmal genauer umzusehen. Er und seine Freunde erkunden gemeinsam ein ehemaliges Bankgebäude, das Auditorium und den Bahnhof Union Train Station.

programme.title: Die Kultschrauber
programme.desc: In Tom's Roadhouse bekommt ein Oldie-VW-Bus aus Arizona eine Frischzellenkur, während bei Lundtauto in Berlin ein Porsche 911 aus den 1970er-Jahren auf eine Komplettrestaurierung wartet. In Hamburg kommen nur britische Originale auf die Hebebühne.

programme.title: Die Kultschrauber
programme.desc: Die Schrauber der Minis Hamburg lassen die Flex kreisen, um Rost von Minis zu entfernen. Porsche-Spezialist Thomas Lundt hat sich der anspruchsvollen Restaurierung von Oldtimern verschrieben, während in Hamburg eine Vespa aufgebaut wird.

programme.title: Die Kultschrauber
programme.desc: In Tom's Roadhouse bekommt der T1-Oldie neue Safari-Fenster, während bei den Roller-Profis der Flying Classics heute eine Ausfahrt ansteht. Motor-Spezialist Michi von den Minis Hamburg setzt bei der Getriebereparatur nicht nur auf seine Erfahrung.

programme.title: Die Kultschrauber
programme.desc: Die frisch lackierte Porsche-Karosse wartet bei Lundt in Berlin auf das Motorfinish, während Manni von den Minis Hamburg eine durchgerostete Tür wieder auf Vordermann bringt. In der Roller-Werkstatt der Flying Classics ist Abschied angesagt.

programme.title: Tracker Diaries - Die Bären von Alaska
programme.desc: Die Crew entdeckt in der Ferne einen einsamen Wolf und nimmt seine Fährte auf. Dabei stoßen sie auf eine altbekannte Bärenfamilie. Durch sie gelangen sie an einen beliebten Ort zum Fischen, wo es vor hungrigen Bären nur so wimmelt.

programme.title: Tracker Diaries - Die Bären von Alaska
programme.desc: In der Nacht findet Casey ein verlassenes Bärenjunges. Am nächsten Tag beginnt er die Suche nach der Familie des kleinen Bären in der Hoffnung, sie wiederzuvereinigen. Auf dem Weg findet er Riedgras, was eine tolle Nahrungsquelle für Bären ist.

programme.title: Tracker Diaries - Die Bären von Alaska
programme.desc: Casey und seine Crew wandern durch den Katmai-Nationalpark. Dort entdecken sie die Knochen eines Buckelwals, der an Land gespült wurde. Doch die Wettervorhersage sieht schlecht aus, weshalb sie ihr Abenteuer womöglich vorzeitig abbrechen müssen.

programme.title: Das geheime Leben der Raubkatzen
programme.desc: Die Dokumentation stellt den sibirischen Tiger in seinem Lebensraum im Fernen Osten vor. Er ist die größte aller lebenden Katzen, doch im vergangenen Jahrhundert kam es zu einem fast vollständigen Zusammenbruch seiner Art.

programme.title: Das geheime Leben der Raubkatzen
programme.desc: Die Dokumentation stellt den Schneeleoparden in seinem Lebensraum im Fernen Osten vor. Das Überleben des Einzelgängers, der sogar im Hochgebirge existieren kann, ist durch Wilderei und Aussterben von Beutetieren stark gefährdet.

programme.title: Das geheime Leben der Raubkatzen
programme.desc: Die Dokumentation behandelt das Leben der Pumas, einer Raubkatze in Nord-, Mittel- und Südamerika. Die mit bis zu zwei Metern Länge größte der Kleinkatzen ist in der Prärie ebenso anzutreffen wie im Dschungel oder auf den Bäumen.

programme.title: Das geheime Leben der Raubkatzen
programme.desc: Die Dokumentation behandelt das Leben der Löwen als König der Savanne in Afrika. Die zusammen mit dem Tiger größte der Raubkatzen lebt im Rudel mit einem Männchen als Alphatier. Das Alphatier muss sich der Konkurrenz der jüngeren Männchen erwehren.

programme.desc: Gigantische Algenteppiche breiten sich unaufhaltsam an den Küsten aus und bedrohen maritime Ökosysteme sowie den lokalen Tourismus. Forscher und Anwohner kämpfen gemeinsam gegen die grüne Flut, um das Gleichgewicht im Meer rasch wiederherzustellen.

programme.title: Reefs of Hope - Die Korallenretter
programme.desc: Weltweit beobachten Wissenschaftler, wie Korallenriffe durch die Erderwärmung stark bedroht sind. Die Wissenschaft versucht deshalb mit neuen Technologien das Absterben zu stoppen und eine Regeneration der Korallenriffe einzuleiten.

programme.title: Twilight-Zone im Ozean
programme.desc: Die Dokumentation begleitet ein Team von Forschern in die mittleren Tiefen des Meeres. Dort gibt es eine Welt voller flimmernder und blinkender Kreaturen. In der "Twilight Zone" der Ozeane warten noch viele verborgene Schätze.

programme.title: Das Wesen der Wale
programme.desc: Wale sind beeindruckend clevere Tiere. Der Regisseur und Biologe Rick Rosenthal taucht mit Walen und erklärt anhand jüngster wissenschaftlicher Erkenntnisse die überraschenden kognitiven Fähigkeiten der riesigen Meeressäuger.

programme.title: Pelagos - Welt der Wale
programme.desc: Der Film zeigt das Leben der Wale und Delfine im Pelagos-Schutzgebiet, das im Mittelmeer liegt.

programme.title: Rettet den Glattwal
programme.desc: Weltweit gibt es geschätzt nur noch 200 bis 250 Exemplare des Nordatlantischen Glattwals. Die meisten Tiere sterben oder verletzen sich durch Zusammenstöße mit Schiffen oder weil sie sich in den Fischernetzen verheddern.

programme.title: Mini-Monster - Australiens flauschige Räuber
programme.desc: Diese Dokumentation zeigt erstmals die Vielfalt der Fleischfresser unter Australiens Beuteltieren. Sie gelten als echte Raubtiere mit Krallen, Pelz - und Beutel. Mit gefletschten Zähnen oder langen Zungen überwältigen sie ihre Opfer.

programme.title: Borneo - Earth's Ancient Eden
programme.desc: Borneo is one of the most biodiverse places on Earth. From the world's oldest tropical rainforests to enormous cave systems, the island's varied and extreme habitats have fueled the evolution of the most bizarre, enigmatic wildlife on the planet.

programme.title: Curiosity
programme.desc: What are you curious about? Whatever it is, it's likely this unprecedented event series created by Discovery founder John Hendricks has it covered. Spanning five years with 60 episodes and companion content across Discovery's networks, "Curiosity" uncovers the truths behind life's most challenging questions, with each episode focusing on a single enduring question in science, technology and society. From the macro to the micro, provocative and insightful subjects are explored to the fullest, a journey for answers undertaken by a different celebrity host every episode. The series premieres with astrophysicist Stephen Hawking renewing the centuries-old debate, "Did God Create the Universe." Other hosts include actors Morgan Freeman, Michelle Rodriguez, Maggie Gyllenhaal and Robin Williams and Discovery Channel personalities Adam Savage and Mike Rowe.

programme.title: Mission Unstoppable
programme.desc: Highlighting the fascinating female innovators who are on the cutting edge of science -- including zoologists, engineers, astronauts, codebreakers and oceanographers. Host Miranda Cosgrove profiles female STEM (science, technology, engineering and math) superstars in the fields of social media, entertainment, animals, design and the internet -- all categories key to the teen experience. Academy Award-winning actress Geena Davis serves as executive producer, bringing her passion for creating change in the portrayal of strong female characters in entertainment and media that positively influences young viewers, along with Cosgrove.

programme.title: What's My Car Worth?
programme.desc: They may think their classic cars are priceless, but owners get a true sense of what their rides are worth in this longtime Velocity series. Sports Car Market magazine Publisher Keith Martin provides the critical, expert eyes auto enthusiasts need to properly determine value. He visits car auctions across the U.S. to test drive some of the world's rarest automobiles for sale, from powerful muscle cars to stylish European sports autos. After an in-depth inspection and a deep dive into each car's history, Martin determines an accurate value before it races across the auction block. Comic/actor Josh Nasar ("Sons of Anarchy") -- a collector car junkie -- joins Martin on many episodes.

programme.title: What Would You Do?
programme.desc: Using hidden cameras, host John Quiñones observes and comments on how ordinary people behave when they are confronted with dilemmas that require them either to take action or to walk by and mind their own business. Various scenarios are created that force people to make split-second -- and often surprising -- decisions, and variations of the situation (such as changing the genders, races or clothing of the people involved) are often featured to see if different reactions are elicited. Examples of situations on the show include a waitress being harassed by her boss, and a drunken valet trying to park cars.

After hearing about the secret garden, Lizzie is disappointed upon arriving to find it in a state of decay, and she endeavors to restore the garden to its past splendor.

programme.desc: During an extended honeymoon in Europe, a restless wife (Mena Suvari) tests her husband's (Jack Huston) devotion by inviting a sultry Italian woman into their inner circle.

programme.title: Man About Town
programme.desc: Hollywood agent Jack Giamoro (Ben Affleck) has a ruthless dedication to his work and a tendency to neglect his wife, Nina (Rebecca Romijn). Upon discovering that Nina has been sleeping with an up-and-coming actor, Giamoro enrolls in a self-help course and begins keeping a diary. But, when that diary, with its tell-all account of Giamoro's professional and personal turmoil, falls into the hands of freelance writer Barbi Ling (Bai Ling), he struggles to retrieve it and prevent a massive scandal.

programme.title: Tucker: The Man and His Dream
programme.desc: Obsessed with cars since childhood, inventor Preston Tucker (Jeff Bridges) has his first successful auto design partnership in the 1930s and designs a successful gun turret for World War II use. With those achievements under his belt, Tucker is determined to create a futuristic car for the masses: the Tucker Torpedo. However, his dreams are challenged by Detroit's auto manufacturers, production problems and accusations of stock fraud, and he is forced to defend his dream and honesty in court.

Burgoyne (Laurence Olivier) to free Dick before he's hanged?

programme.title: Crime of Passion
programme.desc: When newspaper columnist Kathy Ferguson (Barbara Stanwyck) meets cop Bill Doyle (Sterling Hayden), the two quickly hit it off and get married. Kathy gives up her career and heads to Los Angeles with Bill to settle down. The homemaker lifestyle doesn't suit Kathy, however, and she becomes bored with her life and resentful toward Bill because he doesn't share her drive for success. She then secretly decides to make major moves to further Bill's career -- even if it means murdering his rivals.

programme.title: Alexander the Great
programme.desc: The son of Philip of Macedonia (Fredric March) and Olympias (Danielle Darrieux), Alexander the Great (Richard Burton) is one of the most legendary leaders throughout history. As the Macedonian king, Alexander successfully unites all the ancient Greek tribes and leads them to defeat the imposing Persian Empire. With the fall of Babylon, Alexander continues to conquer most of the known world. Eventually, he achieves the status of unparalleled ruler atop his newly formed Greek empire.

Because of this, they defect to the Mexican Army, where they meet guerrilla leader Cortina, with whom they forge an unlikely bond.

Kay Strong (Joanna Pettet), the center of the group, gradually loses faith in the promise of their lives and, as war approaches, becomes unhinged.

programme.desc: From her window, Cheryl Draper (Barbara Stanwyck) sees a neighbor, Albert Richter (George Sanders), murder a young woman. When Cheryl goes to the police, they cannot find any evidence because Richter has hidden the body. Cheryl persists in her claims without evidence, leading concerned policeman Larry Mathews (Gary Merrill) to worry that she is becoming obsessed. After Richter becomes aware of Cheryl's accusations, he conspires to make it appear that she is insane.

What better way to do that than by casting a couple of hot young bodies -- Sally Peters (Judy Lynn) and Cliff Lane (Danny Scholl) -- as eye candy for the viewing public? The plan gets complicated when Jerry falls for Sally, who really loves Cliff. Adapted from the hit Broadway musical, "Top Banana" is notable for filming the actual stage production on the original sets.

Kitty is determined to find the culprit, but the hotheaded Inspector Clancy (Tim Ryan) is also on the case, and, as more bodies pile up at the hotel, the police start to throw accusations at Kitty and her amateur crime-solving crew.

programme.desc: While on naval reserve duty in Tahiti and away from his girlfriend, Dee Dee (Annette Funicello), Frankie (Frankie Avalon) worries that she might be unfaithful. So Frankie hires witch doctor Bwana (Buster Keaton) who dispatches an alluring sea beauty named Cassandra (Beverly Adams) to entice sleazy advertising executive Ricky (Dwayne Hickman) away from Dee Dee. But unexpected complications arise when the beach becomes topsy-turvy after Cassandra arrives.

programme.title: The Haunted Palace
programme.desc: Condemned warlock Joseph Curwen curses a New England village just before being burned alive. More than a century later, Curwen's kindly great-great-grandson Charles Ward (also Price) arrives in town and moves into Curwen's old mansion. Caretaker Simon Orne helps Charles and his wife Ann adjust to their new home. The ancient curse, however, takes hold of Joseph, awakening inside him a long-dormant evil passed on through blood.
