programme.title: The Fall of the House of Usher
programme.desc: Based on the classic story "The Fall of the House of Usher" by Edgar Allan Poe and directed by legendary filmmaker Roger Corman, this thriller features Vincent Price as Roderick Usher, a man who believes his family to be cursed by incurable madness. So sure is he of his family's doom, that when his sister Madeline (Myrna Fahey) announces her engagement to Philip Winthrop (Mark Damon), Roderick will stop at nothing to prevent their marriage and keep the Usher bloodline from continuing.

programme.title: The Vampire
programme.desc: A small-town doctor (John Beal) cannot stop taking the pills that turn him into a fanged killer.

programme.title: Madhouse
programme.desc: The career of horror icon Paul Toombes (Vincent Price) ends in scandal when his fiancée dies under mysterious circumstances. Freed from the mental hospital where he had been committed, the recovered Toombes and screenwriter Herbert Flay (Peter Cushing) intend to revive his most popular character, Dr. Death, for a television series. But the dead bodies start piling up -- all of them killed in ways that mimic the victims in Toombes' films -- and to clear his name he must find the real killer.

programme.title: The Pit and the Pendulum
programme.desc: Elizabeth Barnard Medina (Barbara Steele) has died in the prime of life, and her brother, Francis (John Kerr), wants to know why. Elizabeth's husband, Nicholas (Vincent Price), and her doctor offer differing explanations, but when Francis learns that Nicholas' mother may have been buried alive, he begins to wonder if his sister met the same fate. And when he comes to believe that Elizabeth's spirit wanders about Nicholas' castle, Francis investigates -- and is stunned by what he finds.

programme.title: Voodoo Island

programme.title: The Big Night

programme.title: Lost Lagoon
programme.desc: Charlie Walker (Jeffrey Lynn), a middle-aged businessman, grows weary of his middle-class life and his family. Once there, he mixes with the locals and falls in love with a younger woman, Elizabeth Moore (Leila Barry). But Walker starts to feel the strain of his new life and wonders if he made the right decision.

programme.title: De Sade
programme.desc: The 18th-century French marquis (Keir Dullea) recalls his sadomasochistic experiments and goes to jail for lewd behavior.

programme.title: Toys in the Attic
programme.desc: Black sheep Julian Berniers (Dean Martin) returns home -- along with wife Lily (Yvette Mimieux) -- to his two sisters in New Orleans. Julian's shoe factory in Illinois has gone bankrupt, but he tells them he saved enough money to be comfortable. Julian's sister, Carrie (Geraldine Page), nurses a borderline incestuous affection for Julian and dislikes Lily. When Carrie overhears Julian revealing his money was swindled from Cyrus Warkins (Larry Gates), she convinces naive Lily to betray Julian.

programme.title: Mystery of the 13th Guest
programme.desc: A young woman opens her grandfather's will when she turns 21, and someone starts murdering the heirs.

programme.title: Hit and Run
programme.desc: An old junk dealer's (Hugo Haas) chorus-girl bride (Cleo Moore) and helper (Vince Edwards) run into his twin brother.

programme.title: Things You Can Tell Just by Looking at Her
programme.desc: In California, a group of women struggles with personal problems as their paths intertwine in unexpected ways. Dr. Elaine Keener, the sole caretaker for her aging mother, turns to tarot card reader Christine for spiritual aid. Christine grapples with her own angst due to her lover's debilitating illness. Meanwhile, a bank manager deals with an unwanted pregnancy, two sisters pursue romantic interests and a housewife gets back into the dating game.

programme.title: Popi
programme.desc: Genial Puerto Rican widower Abraham Rodriguez, known as "Popi" to his preteen sons, grapples with poverty and hardship in their Spanish Harlem neighborhood. Desperate to provide his sons every opportunity to succeed, and noting the reverence with which Americans treat Cuban immigrants, Popi lights upon a wild scheme. He sets his boys afloat in a boat off the coast of Florida, confident that they will be "rescued" as Cuban refugees and adopted by wealthy patrons.

programme.title: Beach Party
programme.desc: Dolores (Annette Funicello) and Frankie (Frankie Avalon), attractive young surfers in Southern California, are just out for a good time. Their relaxed lifestyle fascinates Professor Sutwell (Bob Cummings), an anthropologist who decides to study the social lives of teens. A series of beach-themed films would follow the blueprint set by this one, which hinges on romantic rivalries, rugged motorcyclists, an attempted crime and plenty of handsome people.

programme.title: So Young, So Bad

They're proven correct when several girls at the school attempt an escape.

programme.title: Diary of a Hitman
programme.desc: A veteran hit man, Dekker (Forest Whitaker) is ready to call it quits and leave the profession. Dekker's final job, however, proves to be trickier than expected when the sadistic Zidzyck (Lewis Smith) recruits the assassin to kill his wife, Jain (Sherilyn Fenn), along with the couple's baby. While Dekker has a change of heart and resolves not to shoot Jain and her child, his decision places all their lives in danger, since Zidzyck has dispatched another killer to perform the task.

programme.title: Cult of the Damned
programme.desc: An unscrupulous rock star brings decadence and debauchery to a naive young woman's wealthy household.

programme.title: The Trip
programme.desc: Paul (Peter Fonda), a director saddened by his failed marriage and unsatisfied with his work, is looking to start over. His friend, the cool, sage-like John (Bruce Dern), suggests that an LSD trip is exactly what Paul needs to get out of his rut. Paul decides to indulge, and experiences visions that are alternately beautiful and terrifying. His hallucinations, which include a carnival populated by dwarfs, bizarrely erotic encounters and even his own death, radically reshape his consciousness.

programme.title: The Miracle Worker
programme.desc: Blind and deaf after suffering a terrible fever as a baby, young Helen Keller (Patty Duke) has spent years unable to communicate, leaving her frustrated and occasionally violent. As a last chance before she is institutionalized, her parents (Inga Swenson, Andrew Prine) contact a school for the blind, which sends half-blind Annie Sullivan (Anne Bancroft) to teach Helen. Helen is initially resistant, but Annie gradually forms a bond with her and shows Helen ways of reaching others.

rating.system: Departamento de Justiça, Classificação, Títulos e Qualificação

programme.title: The Emerald Forest
programme.desc: American Bill Markham (Powers Boothe) has taken his family to the jungles of Brazil, where he has been hired to design a dam. Unexpectedly, a native tribe abducts his son, Tommy (Charley Boorman). Bill spends an entire decade looking for Tommy, only to discover that the boy has adopted the ways of the indigenous people he's been living with. Bill tries to convince his son to return to his family, but their reunion is interrupted when another group of natives attacks Tommy's tribe.

programme.title: Something Wild
programme.desc: When college girl Mary Ann Robinson (Carroll Baker) is attacked and raped, her world is shattered. Unable to carry on a normal routine with her critical mother, Mary Ann takes a room in a New York City hovel and accepts a job at a dime store as she struggles to come to grips with her ordeal. Sinking into isolation, she attempts suicide and is saved by a concerned bystander, lonely auto mechanic Mike (Ralph Meeker). Mary Ann moves in with Mike but soon questions his motives for wanting to help.

programme.title: Buona Sera, Mrs. Campbell
programme.desc: During World War II, an Italian villager (Gina Lollobrigida) befriends three American soldiers. Later, when unsure which of them fathered the daughter she has, she invents a dead captain named Campbell, declares herself his widow and accepts support checks from all three soldiers. Twenty years later, a reunion unexpectedly brings the three veterans -- and their wives and children -- back to Italy. Mrs. Campbell panics as she endeavors to keep her lively past from her daughter.

It takes Mike a long time and a lot of physical therapy to get back on the job, but he does -- and coincidentally finds himself protecting a client whom Hansen and his gang are simultaneously being paid to assassinate.

programme.title: Little Norse Prince Valiant
programme.desc: A Norwegian prince fights evil with a rock man's sword of the sun.

programme.title: The Purple Plain
programme.desc: At the end of World War II in Burma, Canadian Royal Air Force pilot Forrester (Gregory Peck) is a loner whose bravery can't cover a streak of reckless instability. When his actions cause an injury, he is nearly transferred, but Dr. Harris (Bernard Lee) recommends pulling him from duty, due to the emotional trauma he's suffered. Forrester then accompanies Harris to a Christian missionary outpost, where he meets Anna (Win Min Than) and begins to find interest in living again.

programme.title: The Secret of NIMH 2: Timmy to the Rescue
programme.desc: In this animated film, after recovering from an illness that plagued him in his youth, country mouse Timmy Brisby (Ralph Macchio) grows into a strong young rodent. And when fellow Thorn Valley resident Jenny McBride (Hynden Walsh) begs him to find her missing mother and father, he gets the opportunity to prove himself worthy of the Brisby name. Timmy sets out on a journey that puts him on a collision course with wicked mouse Martin (Eric Idle) and the dreaded National Institute of Mental Health.

rating.system: Departamento de Justiça, Classificação, Títulos e Qualificação

programme.title: Sea Fury
programme.desc: The first mate (Stanley Baker) of a British salvage boat rivals his captain (Victor McLaglen) for a Spanish girl (Luciana Paluzzi).

programme.title: Black Girl
programme.desc: The 17-year-old dreamer Billie Jean is the youngest in a family of loving yet discouraging women. Billie Jean's mother, Mama Rosie, cares deeply about her three biological children. However, her own personal disappointments have left her embittered, and she only offers encouragement to her adopted daughter, Netta. When Netta, a successful teacher, returns to visit the family, she may be the voice of guidance and hope Billie Jean desperately needs.

programme.title: Visit to a Chief's Son
programme.desc: When a Western anthropologist, Robert (Richard Mulligan), brings his son, Kevin (John Philip Hogdon), to Kenya to document an eclipse and a remote Masai tribe's reaction to it, both father and son are in for a serious case of culture shock. Used to Western comforts, Kevin is at first hesitant and uncomfortable among the natives, but the English-speaking son of the tribe's chief, Nemolok (Johnny Sekka), helps familiarize Kevin with his culture, opening his eyes to a new way of life.

programme.title: The Kitchen Toto
programme.desc: In the 1950s Kenya, a preacher (Nathan Dambuza Mdledle) speaks out against the Mau Mau terrorists and is killed for it, leaving his young son, Mwangi (Edwin Mahinda), to fend for himself. Mwangi goes to work in the kitchen of the local British police chief, John Graham (Bob Peck), who welcomes him -- though his wife (Phyllis Logan) and son (Ronald Pirie) treat Mwangi with contempt. Things worsen when the Mau Mau intercede in his life again, this time demanding that Mwangi ally himself with them.

programme.title: Anna Lucasta
programme.desc: Anna Lucasta has been walking the streets in San Diego since being thrown out of home, at 19, by her alcoholic father, Joe. She's estranged from her family, but when her father and brother-in-law see greedy potential in an arranged marriage to affluent Rudolph, Anna is called back home. Old wounds have hardly healed, though. Just as Anna starts to feel for Rudolph, Danny, an old friend, returns to make life difficult.

programme.title: Halls of Anger
programme.desc: The court-ordered desegregation of an inner-city Los Angeles high school brings 60 white students into the predominantly African-American student body. African-American teacher Quincy Davis (Calvin Lockhart) reaches out to all his students, enticing Lerone (DeWayne Jessie) to advance his reading skills with racy paperbacks, protecting new student Douglas (Jeff Bridges) after a race-motivated beating and trying to quell a potential student strike led by the militant J.T. (James A. Watson Jr.).

programme.title: Across 110th Street
programme.desc: After a robbery in Harlem turns into a scene of mass murder, promising young black police officer William Pope (Yaphet Kotto) is assigned to the case, along with surly, prejudiced Italian-American cop Frank Mattelli (Anthony Quinn). The pair clashes during their tense investigation as they try to track down the three suspects and apprehend them. Also searching for the fugitives is ruthless mobster Nick D'Salvio (Tony Franciosa), who will stop at nothing to retrieve the stolen money.

rating.system: Departamento de Justiça, Classificação, Títulos e Qualificação

programme.title: Truck Turner
programme.desc: Bounty hunter Mack "Truck" Turner (Isaac Hayes) almost always finds his target, but his latest prize -- a pimp called Gator (Paul Harris) -- is killed while Turner is chasing him. Gator's girl, Dorinda (Nichelle Nichols), vows to avenge his death and offers ownership of her successful call-girl operation to anyone who can knock off Turner. Upscale pimp Harvard Blue (Yaphet Kotto) steps in, upping the ante with professional assassins. Turner, however, isn't going down easily.

programme.title: Drum
programme.desc: A slaver (Warren Oates) buys Drum (Ken Norton), a bordello queen's (Silvia Pinal) son, in the 1860s New Orleans.

programme.title: Friday Foster
programme.desc: On assignment from her editor, photographer Friday Foster (Pam Grier) travels to an airport to capture a few shots of the richest black man in the United States (Thalmus Rasulala). But it turns out Foster isn't the only one taking shots as she witnesses -- and photographs -- an assassination attempt on her subject. With definitive evidence in her possession, she also becomes a target of the assassins. Joining a private eye (Yaphet Kotto), Foster sets out to discover the truth behind the attempt.

programme.title: The Monkey Hustle
programme.desc: Slick Chicago street hustler Big Daddy Foxx (Yaphet Kotto) lives comfortably off petty confidence scams that he pulls with the help of loyal teenage acolytes Baby D' (Kirk Calloway), Tiny (Donn Harper) and Player (Thomas Carter). His business is jeopardized, however, when he runs afoul of neighborhood racketeer Goldie (Rudy Ray Moore). Their rivalry escalates until the threat of a freeway being built through their neighborhood obliges them to cooperate in order to fight city hall.

programme.title: I Escaped From Devil's Island
programme.desc: A convicted murderer leads a band of men through shark-infested waters in an attempt to escape the fortress prison.

programme.title: Slaughter
programme.desc: After his parents are killed by a car bomb, a former Green Beret named Slaughter (Jim Brown) begins investigating and is shocked to discover they were targets of a Mafia hit. He decides to settle the score on his own and successfully takes out some of the gangsters responsible before being caught by police. Now faced with a murder charge, Slaughter strikes a deal with government officials to have the charges dropped provided he can find and kill another gangster who's since fled to Mexico.

programme.title: Crack House
programme.desc: Rick (Gregg Thomsen) and Melissa (Cheryl Kay) are two young lovebirds struggling against the crime and poverty of the Los Angeles ghetto they inhabit. Their hopes of ever leaving are destroyed when one of Rick's relatives is killed in a drive-by shooting. Seeking to avenge the vicious murder, Rick rejoins his former gang, but gets himself arrested. During his absence, Melissa becomes involved with drug dealers and is addicted to crack. Rick then sets out on a difficult mission to save her.

programme.title: Original Gangstas
programme.desc: Successful Los Angeles football coach John Bookman returns home to Gary, IN, when his father is murdered. Discovering the town overrun with violent street gangs, John is even more horrified to learn his father was shot by a member of the Rebels, a gang John himself helped form in his youth. John teams up with Jake and Laurie, the parents of a boy who was also killed by a Rebel, to organize their neighborhood against gang violence.

programme.title: Soda Cracker
programme.desc: A Chicago police officer practices his own brand of justice to take down the killers who murdered his partner.

programme.title: I Escaped From Devil's Island
programme.desc: A convicted murderer leads a band of men through shark-infested waters in an attempt to escape the fortress prison.

programme.title: Slaughter
programme.desc: After his parents are killed by a car bomb, a former Green Beret named Slaughter (Jim Brown) begins investigating and is shocked to discover they were targets of a Mafia hit. He decides to settle the score on his own and successfully takes out some of the gangsters responsible before being caught by police. Now faced with a murder charge, Slaughter strikes a deal with government officials to have the charges dropped provided he can find and kill another gangster who's since fled to Mexico.

programme.title: Crack House
programme.desc: Rick (Gregg Thomsen) and Melissa (Cheryl Kay) are two young lovebirds struggling against the crime and poverty of the Los Angeles ghetto they inhabit. Their hopes of ever leaving are destroyed when one of Rick's relatives is killed in a drive-by shooting. Seeking to avenge the vicious murder, Rick rejoins his former gang, but gets himself arrested. During his absence, Melissa becomes involved with drug dealers and is addicted to crack. Rick then sets out on a difficult mission to save her.

programme.title: Hollywood Shuffle
programme.desc: Aspiring actor and hot-dog stand employee Bobby Taylor (Robert Townsend) catches the ire of his grandmother (Helen Martin) for auditioning for a role in the regrettably titled exploitation film Jivetime Jimmy's Revenge. When Tinseltown Studios casts Taylor in the title role, he has a series of conflicted dreams satirizing African-American stereotypes in Hollywood, and must reconcile his career goals with his desire to remain a positive role model for his little brother (Craigus R Johnson).

programme.title: Cotton Comes to Harlem
programme.desc: Harlem's African-American population is being ripped off by the Rev. Deke O'Malley (Calvin Lockhart), who dishonestly claims that small donations will secure parcels of land in Africa. When New York City police officers Gravedigger Jones (Godfrey Cambridge) and Coffin Ed Johnson (Raymond St. Jacques) look into O'Malley's scam, they learn that the cash is being smuggled inside a bale of cotton. But the police, O'Malley and lots of others find themselves scrambling when the money goes missing.

programme.title: Carbon Copy
programme.desc: Walter Whitney is a successful executive who resides in an upscale Southern California suburb. Like all of his friends and neighbors, Walter is white, and he is shocked when he learns he has a son he never knew about -- black teen Roger Porter (Denzel Washington). Despite his surprise, Walter welcomes Roger into his home; unfortunately, the less accepting Mrs. Whitney (Susan Saint James) boots both of them out of the house, and Walter's racist boss fires him, leaving him in a tough spot.

programme.title: Body and Soul
programme.desc: Leon Johnson (Leon Isaac Kennedy) is a boxer who plans to study medicine, but, with his ailing sister, Kelly (Nikki Swassy), in need of costly care, he decides to earn a living in the ring. His rise is rapid, but Leon's newly extravagant lifestyle threatens his relationship with girlfriend Julie (Jayne Kennedy). As Leon approaches the sport's highest echelons, he faces increasingly tough decisions that test his loyalty to his family and himself.

programme.title: Hammer
programme.desc: Hotheaded laborer B.J. Hammer (Fred Williamson) can't go long without ending up in a fight, and, after he comes out on top in a particularly impressive workplace scuffle, word of his brawling skills makes its way to Davis (Bernie Hamilton), a top boxing manager. Hammer is hired by Davis and begins a lucrative career in the ring, only to find out that his new employer wants him to throw a fight and take part in other illicit activities. Hammer reacts to this news violently, and the feud is on.

programme.title: Penitentiary
programme.desc: Hitchhiker Martel "Too Sweet" Gordone gets a lift from prostitute Linda in her van and travels with her to meet her clients. After a fight breaks out with the men, Gordone is knocked unconscious and awakens to find he has been wrongly charged with murder. As a way to protect himself in prison, Gordone starts fighting other inmates. This leads him to discover an underground boxing tournament, with the top prize being a prison release.

programme.title: Penitentiary II
programme.desc: Boxer "Too Sweet" Gordone (Leon Isaac Kennedy) tries keeping his nose clean after being paroled from prison. He could box, but he doesn't want to go back to that life. He works as a deliveryman instead, and starts seeing his old girlfriend, Clarisse (Eugenia Wright). But a psychotic criminal, Half Dead (Ernie Hudson), who was Gordone's enemy in prison, breaks out and kills Clarisse as payback. The murder forces Gordone back into the ring, and he is desperate to get revenge against Half Dead.

programme.title: A Reason to Live, A Reason to Die
programme.desc: After surrendering Fort Holman to the Confederacy without there being a single shot fired, Col. Pembroke (James Coburn) faces public disgrace and a potential court-martial unless he's able to recapture the fort now held by the power-mad Maj. Ward (Telly Savalas). To help him on this mission, Pembroke enlists a ragtag bunch of condemned men who are promised their freedom should they survive. Despite much internal strife, the group gradually comes together in time for the assault.

programme.title: Escort West
programme.desc: In the wake of the Civil War, ex-Confederate soldier Ben Lassiter and his 10-year-old daughter, Abbey, are traveling through Nevada when they cross paths with sisters Martha and Beth Drury. Although Martha is embittered because her fiancé was killed by a Confederate during the war, she is forced to trust Ben when a band of Native Americans tries to attack the sisters, and the soldier offers his protection.

programme.title: Canyon Crossroads
programme.desc: Henchmen in a helicopter chase a Utah prospector (Richard Basehart) seeking uranium with a professor and his daughter (Phyllis Kirk).

programme.title: Wild Horse Stampede
programme.desc: The Trail Blazers (Ken Maynard, Hoot Gibson) stop horse rustlers for Indians and a railroad.

programme.title: Bat Masterson
programme.desc: Bat faces a series of challenges as his crew builds a railroad in Colorado, including natural disasters, lost equipment and charges against Bat for a murder he didn't commit.

programme.title: Bat Masterson
programme.desc: When Bat comes to the aid of a marshal friend in Dodge City to stop a power-hungry land baron named Silas Guild, he learns the marshal's intentions are less than noble.

programme.title: Tombstone Territory
programme.desc: Billy Clanton makes a pass at Lisa Carew, getting into a fight with her father, who has promised Lisa to Johnny Coster; Lisa runs away from her home.

programme.title: Tombstone Territory
programme.desc: After discovering his wife has been kidnapped, a man recently released from prison learns that she will be released if he kills Clay Hollister.

programme.title: Gun Fight
programme.desc: After finishing a stint as a cavalryman, Wayne Santley (James Brown) is looking forward to taking a job on his brother's ranch. While traveling to see his sibling, he helps entertainer Nora (Joan Staley) out of a sticky situation with an aggressive suitor, and promptly falls in love with her. But when he and Nora finally meet up with Wayne's brother, Brad (Gregg Palmer), they learn the ranch is just a front for a crime ring. Wayne is appalled, leading to a feud between the brothers.

programme.title: A Dog's Best Friend
programme.desc: Married ranchers (Bill Williams, Marcia Henderson) take in an ungrateful boy (Roger Mobley) who befriends a slain hermit's German shepherd.

programme.title: The Gunfight at Dodge City
programme.desc: Gambler and gunman Bat Masterson (Joel McCrea) rides into Dodge City, Kan., to visit his straight-arrow brother, Ed (Harry Lauter), who is hoping to defeat crooked sheriff Jim Regan (Don Haggerty) in an upcoming election. Bat purchases and renovates a rundown saloon, attracting the notice of Regan's henchmen. A shooting during the saloon's opening-night celebration causes Bat to pursue his own political vendetta against Regan and attempt to clean up the town's corruption once and for all.

programme.title: Man With the Gun
programme.desc: Sheridan City is out of control. The citizens are corrupt, the saloon is an immoral indulgence, and gunmen and greedy opportunists come and go as they please. With the town's lawman (Henry Hull) incapable of maintaining order, the town council brings in a hired gun, Clint Tollinger (Robert Mitchum), who has business of his own with the saloon madame (Jan Sterling). Tollinger sets about proving his reputation as a "town tamer" through his signature approach: eradicating violence with violence.

programme.title: The Mercenary
programme.desc: Sergei Kowalski, a mercenary only out for himself and a few dollars, joins up with a Mexican peasant-turned-revolutionary, Paco Roman, when the price is right. No longer content to toil for the rich and powerful, Roman plans to bring a new order to Mexico by force with his small ragtag group. While Roman and Kowalski are outnumbered facing the Mexican army, they also have to contend with Curly, a vengeful killer out for blood.

programme.title: Robbers' Roost
programme.desc: An outlaw attempting to go straight while tracking down one of his wife's killers, Jim "Tex" Wall (George Montgomery) finds work on a ranch operated by disabled cattle owner "Bull" Herrick (Bruce Bennett). As Tex begins to fall for Bull's pretty sister, Helen (Sylvia Findley), he also has to face off against two feuding gangs of rustlers, one led by the tough Heesman (Peter Graves). Can Tex escape his shady past and finally end his mission of vengeance?

programme.title: Gun Duel in Durango
programme.desc: Bank robber Will Sabre is looking to leave his life of crime behind in favor of marrying his sweetheart, Judy. But Sabre's gang, led by Dunsten, has no intention of letting go of such a skilled shootist. When he rejects the demand to rejoin their ranks, these cruel crooks promptly use their next heist to frame the innocent Sabre. To save his reputation and future, he must set out to capture his former cohorts -- with the law in hot pursuit.

programme.title: The Iroquois Trail
programme.desc: Trapper Hawkeye (George Montgomery) and guide Sagamore help a British captain (Glenn Langan) in the French and Indian War.

programme.title: The Lone Gun
programme.desc: A marshal (George Montgomery) courts a rancher's sister (Dorothy Malone) and rids a town of rustlers.

programme.title: Toughest Gun in Tombstone
programme.desc: Before initiating an undercover investigation in Tombstone, Ariz., Capt. Matt Sloane (George Montgomery) sets out to build a reputation for himself as a ruthless man. Sloane distributes "wanted" circulars describing his supposed criminal exploits; drops off his young son, Terry (Scotty Morrow), with a friend; and joins a vicious gang headed up by his target: reckless outlaw Johnny Ringo (Jim Davis). As Sloane works his way into Ringo's inner circle, Terry flees home in search of his father.

programme.title: Gun Belt
programme.desc: After giving up his gunfighting ways, Billy Ringo (George Montgomery) has settled down with his new wife, Arlene (Helen Westcott), on a ranch he's just purchased with his brother, Matt (John Dehner), and nephew Chip (Tab Hunter). But when Matt tricks him into participating in a bank robbery -- and frames him as the ringleader -- Billy is forced to go on the run from lawman Wyatt Earp (James Millican), and once again take up his guns against his former rival, Ike Clinton (William Bishop).

programme.title: Noose for a Gunman
programme.desc: Gunslinger Case Britton (Jim Davis) isn't welcome in his hometown of Rock Valley. He's still wanted for the murder of the Avery brothers, the sons of local tycoon Carl Avery (Barton MacLane). He's forced back into Rock Valley, however, because he's received word that outlaw Jack Cantrell (Ted de Corsia) plans on robbing a stagecoach that is coming into town. As Case struggles to earn the trust of the locals, he begins to suspect that Avery may have something to do with the planned robbery.

programme.title: Fort Massacre
programme.desc: After his cavalry company is decimated by an Apache attack, Vinson takes charge and tries to lead his remaining men to safety. Unfortunately, his pathological hatred of Native Americans causes him to commit rash acts that put his troops in jeopardy. The enlisted men, especially the rebellious McGurney, question Vinson's leadership and even his morality, but the soldiers must stick together if they wish to make it through Apache lands.

programme.title: The Ride Back
programme.desc: Determined to redeem his life as a failure, Sheriff Chris Hamish crosses the Mexican border to find an outlaw named Kallen and extradite him to Texas for a fair trial. Hamish arrests Kallen, who doubts the sheriff's ability to bring him to justice and makes several attempts to escape. But when they run into a group of murderous Apaches, Hamish and Kallen must fight together to survive, and they form an unlikely friendship.

programme.title: Sitting Bull
programme.desc: Recognizing that Maj. Robert Parrish (Dale Robertson) has a history of making peace with Native American tribes, President Ulysses S. Grant (John Hamilton) sends him to iron out a land dispute with Chief Sitting Bull (J. Carrol Naish). Though negotiations seem to be going well, Parrish can't stop the deadly Battle of Little Big Horn. Many die, but when he helps Sitting Bull survive, Parrish is charged with crimes against the government, and he will be executed unless Grant steps in.

programme.title: Westward Bound
programme.desc: Corrupt politician Albert Lane (Weldon Heyburn), town councilor Roger Caldwell (Harry Woods) and tax agent Henry Wagner (Karl Hackett) plot to steal the land of Montana ranchers. The ranchers, led by feisty Jasper Tuttle (Hal Price) and Enid Barrett (Betty Miles), band together to fight back. With the help of a trio of virtuous U.S. marshals called the Trail Blazers (Ken Maynard, Hoot Gibson, Bob Steele), the honest ranchers tangle with the politicians' henchmen.

programme.title: The Dalton Girls
programme.desc: After the criminal Dalton brothers are slain, two of the brothers' eldest daughters, Holly and Rose, get into an altercation with an undertaker and are forced to kill him. On the run from Detective Hiram Parsh, who pursued the Dalton brothers for years, Holly and Rose take assumed names and begin a life of petty crime in order to get money to send their younger sisters, Columbine and Marigold, to school in the East.

District Attorney Temple Houston (Bill Williams) must put aside his friendship with the chief and budding romance with the chief's daughter, Ruth Red Hawk (Gloria Talbott), to prosecute the case. Although Buffalo Horn has a solid alibi for the time of the killing, the political and business corruption of the territory makes a fair trial difficult.

programme.title: The Hallelujah Trail

programme.title: It's a Mann's World
programme.desc: Multitalented entertainers David and Tamela Mann are known mostly for their stage and screen collaborations with producer Tyler Perry ("Meet the Browns"). "It's a Mann's World" provides fans a view of the couple behind the camera -- at home, attending exclusive events, and spending time with famous friends. The hourlong episodes show how David and Tamela balance being celebrities, entrepreneurs and parents to four adult children while maintaining their marriage of 20-plus years.

programme.title: The Verdict With Judge Hatchett
programme.desc: Judge Glenda Hatchett presided over her self-titled courtroom show from 2000-2008. Now, she returns to the medium with "The Verdict." In the half-hour series, the Atlanta native and former juvenile-court judge rules over small-claims cases brought in front of her. Hatchett's courtroom isn't just about finding someone guilty, though. She also uses her experience dealing with young people and her tough-love approach to help send a message to out-of-control juvenile offenders to try to set them on the right track in their lives.

Each episode features two teams in the Think Tank -- a studio filled with art supplies and construction materials -- who brainstorm and choose materials before sketching, designing and building a prototype to be presented to a judge, who determines a winner. The champions earn bragging rights and the coveted Genius Cup.

programme.title: America's Heartland
programme.desc: Much of the food Americans eat is produced by farmers and ranchers in the country's heartland, but many people don't know how it's produced. "America's Heartland" provides information about the people and processes responsible for the availability of food and fuel across the country and around the world. The show's reporters and producers tell stories in topics that include farm families, consumer issues, animal welfare and crop sustainability. Some episodes also take the show abroad to countries such as Egypt and Taiwan to show the impact American agriculture has on the global economy.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Al final de la década de los ochentas, en el negocio ilícito más lucrativo de la época, "el oro blanco", las rutas de las Bahamas y Florida, ya no son tan viables para el transporte de la cocaína; la persecución de los miembros de los carteles colombianos y su guerra entre ellos mismos se intensifica, generando que estos bandidos sean extraditados, encarcelados en su país o asesinados. Algunos son condenados al encierro voluntario, escondidos en algún rincón para evitar su captura, por cuenta de las fuerzas armadas o de sus enemigos. El negocio cambia y es cuando aparece Amado Carrillo Fuentes "El Señor de los Cielos" que en forma muy discreta se dedica al transporte del producto que proveen los narcotraficantes colombianos restantes, convirtiéndose en el narcotraficante más poderoso de los cuatro carteles que operan en México: el de Juárez, el del Golfo, el de Sinaloa y el de Tijuana. Su historia se devela en este drama cargado de acción y giros inusitados.

programme.title: Lo que callamos las mujeres
programme.desc: Esta serie dramática representa en cada capítulo de una hora historias distintas y reales sobre mujeres mexicanas que atraviesan diferentes vicisitudes. Las experiencias de estas mujeres tratan de temas censurados por la sociedad y por lo tanto ellas los enfrentan en silencio, algunas de las situaciones que se examinan son: el abuso infantil, el embarazo no deseado, asesinatos, la pornografía y la violencia familiar entre otras. Al final de cada episodio se muestra una lista de centros o agencias de ayuda para personas que se sientan identificadas con los casos específicos, se hace un llamado para que busquen ayuda y rompan su silencio.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Al final de la década de los ochentas, en el negocio ilícito más lucrativo de la época, "el oro blanco", las rutas de las Bahamas y Florida, ya no son tan viables para el transporte de la cocaína; la persecución de los miembros de los carteles colombianos y su guerra entre ellos mismos se intensifica, generando que estos bandidos sean extraditados, encarcelados en su país o asesinados. Algunos son condenados al encierro voluntario, escondidos en algún rincón para evitar su captura, por cuenta de las fuerzas armadas o de sus enemigos. El negocio cambia y es cuando aparece Amado Carrillo Fuentes "El Señor de los Cielos" que en forma muy discreta se dedica al transporte del producto que proveen los narcotraficantes colombianos restantes, convirtiéndose en el narcotraficante más poderoso de los cuatro carteles que operan en México: el de Juárez, el del Golfo, el de Sinaloa y el de Tijuana. Su historia se devela en este drama cargado de acción y giros inusitados.

programme.title: ¿Quién tiene la razón?
programme.desc: Programa de charlas en el que los participantes invitados exponen sus casos ante la presentadora buscando consejo profesional. Los casos incluyen conflictos en temas variados, entre familias, parejas y amigos o relacionados. Ella guía con preguntas y consejos a los participantes y en muchos casos los confronta y acusa para que acepten sus errores cometidos por hecho o negligencia. A su lado la acompañan un grupo de tres panelistas, quienes eligen individualmente con quién están de acuerdo o en desacuerdo, después de haber escuchado atentamente a las partes en cuestión. También acompañando a la doctora Âlvarez está la audiencia presente en el estudio formando parte activa del show; la cual entrega el veredicto final, eligiendo por votación al panelista que tiene la razón o en algunos casos concluyendo que ninguno tiene la razón.

La anfitriona del programa se encarga de conducir a los panelistas para exponer sus casos en forma clara, sacar una conclusión al problema y tratar de solucionarlo, gracias a su carisma y habilidad para conectarse con sus invitados de una manera positiva con sus análisis objetivos, ella, por lo general encuentra la solución a los conflictos. Los temas tratados son diversos, incluyendo conflictos familiares, problemas entre socios, infidelidad, paternidad, entre otros.

programme.title: El Palenque

programme.title: ¿Quién tiene la razón?
programme.desc: Programa de charlas en el que los participantes invitados exponen sus casos ante la presentadora buscando consejo profesional. Los casos incluyen conflictos en temas variados, entre familias, parejas y amigos o relacionados. Ella guía con preguntas y consejos a los participantes y en muchos casos los confronta y acusa para que acepten sus errores cometidos por hecho o negligencia. A su lado la acompañan un grupo de tres panelistas, quienes eligen individualmente con quién están de acuerdo o en desacuerdo, después de haber escuchado atentamente a las partes en cuestión. También acompañando a la doctora Âlvarez está la audiencia presente en el estudio formando parte activa del show; la cual entrega el veredicto final, eligiendo por votación al panelista que tiene la razón o en algunos casos concluyendo que ninguno tiene la razón.

programme.title: ¿Quién tiene la razón?
programme.desc: Programa de charlas en el que los participantes invitados exponen sus casos ante la presentadora buscando consejo profesional. Los casos incluyen conflictos en temas variados, entre familias, parejas y amigos o relacionados. Ella guía con preguntas y consejos a los participantes y en muchos casos los confronta y acusa para que acepten sus errores cometidos por hecho o negligencia. A su lado la acompañan un grupo de tres panelistas, quienes eligen individualmente con quién están de acuerdo o en desacuerdo, después de haber escuchado atentamente a las partes en cuestión. También acompañando a la doctora Âlvarez está la audiencia presente en el estudio formando parte activa del show; la cual entrega el veredicto final, eligiendo por votación al panelista que tiene la razón o en algunos casos concluyendo que ninguno tiene la razón.

programme.title: Historias de la Virgen morena
programme.desc: A veces los problemas del día a día pueden solucionarse con un poco de ayuda milagrosa. Esta exitosa serie muestra casos de la vida real en los cuales los protagonistas se enfrentan a grandes encrucijadas o a situaciones terribles, y no les queda más remedio que pedir un milagro. Es allí cuando la fe se pone a prueba y se vuelve poderosa, pues demuestra que de la situación más terrible se puede salir. Pensado para quienes creen que la fe mueve montañas, esta conmovedora serie muestra la manera en la que los protagonistas se encomiendan a la Virgen Morena buscando resolver sus dificultades.

programme.desc: Hace treinta años, los extraterrestres llegaron a la Tierra en busca de un refugio ante la muerte de su planeta. Cuando un agente contrae un virus que empieza a alterar su ADN, sólo hay un lugar en donde se puede esconder: Distrito 9.

programme.title: Santo Rosario

programme.desc: Se descubre el inmenso tesoro que es la fe católica, su historia, sacramentos, liturgia y magisterio para que al conocerla se cree una mayor conexión.

programme.title: Coronilla a la Divina Misericordia
programme.desc: Conjunto de oraciones que muestran devoción a la Divina Misericordia de Dios.

programme.title: Donde Dios llora

programme.title: Congresos católicos
programme.desc: Un programa para revivir y meditar los mensajes y conferencias impartidas en los diferentes eventos de El Sembrador, congresos, Metanoias, misiones y otros.

programme.title: En el corazón de Jesús

programme.title: La Santa Misa
programme.desc: Transmisión de la Santa Misa. Celebración católica en la que se renueva el sacrificio del calvario y se celebra el sacramento de la eucaristía. Por medio de la consagración del pan y el vino, el sacerdote entrega el cuerpo y la sangre de Cristo a los fieles, para el perdón de los pecados y el fortalecimiento de la fe. programme.title: La ruleta de la suerte
programme.desc: Una de las versiones españolas del programa de concurso clásico norteamericano de gran acogida que se inició en los años setenta, titulado "Wheel of Fortune" o la "Ruleta de la fortuna" en español. Este formato se ha realizado en más de 25 países y se ha extendido al público internacional. Los concursantes deben adivinar oraciones sobre temas variados, llenando los vacíos con letras adivinadas que ellos enuncian, el que adivine una letra perteneciente a la frase gana un premio monetario y el premio se incrementa si adivina la frase completa. Se realizan varias rondas, en la que se incrementa la dificultad y la complejidad de los temas que se abordan.

programme.title: Planeta helado
programme.desc: El equipo que produjo la serie ganadora del premio Emmy, "Planet Earth" de la Unidad de Historia Natural de la BBC y de Discovery Channel combinan sus esfuerzos una vez más para crear este documental magnífico de siete partes. Grabado en su totalidad en alta definición e incluye cinematografía con tecnología de punta, para capturar el comportamiento de los animales sin ser disturbados, este programa hace una crónica de los ecosistemas y de los animales del Ártico y el Antártico, lugares en el que los cineastas pasaron 2.300 días y en el océano 18 meses para grabar cortos sin precedentes. Los episodios siguen las vidas de los osos polares, los lobos, las ballenas asesinas y los pingüinos, desde la primavera hasta el invierno y además hay un episodio que detalla los desafíos enfrentados por el equipo que realizó el documental. La serie es narrada por Alec Baldwin y el séptimo episodio incluye una visión sobre los efectos del calentamiento global en los polos y el resto.

La serie se transmite en tres ediciones nocturnas, luego se re-transmite la última edición cuatro veces cada mañana de lunes a viernes antes de despejar el escenario para un bloque de seis horas de "SportsCenter" en vivo, que pone más énfasis en la interactividad de los fanáticos, noticias, análisis, comentarios y la cobertura de las conferencias de prensa.

programme.title: 請帖 / Rendezvous With Death
programme.desc: 青年俠士辛酸得悉王爺擬委託四大殺手押送神秘箱子往西安，且將付出十萬兩銀子作酬金，辛遂殺四人及持其頭顱往見王爺，求接辦保鏢事，蓋辛欲得該筆巨額酬金作賑災之用，王爺允之。辛途遇妙手怪丐楊風、無形劍客古非天及美豔女俠水仙花等高手截劫。原來當中牽涉通敵叛國的陰謀...

programme.title: 銷魂玉 / Return Of The Dead
programme.desc: 王致和無意得到通靈玩意，許下三個願望，雖然願望靈驗之極，結果落得家散人亡；風塵女孟薇被情人林坤全害死，變成水鬼復仇；豔麗女子蕭雲玉香消玉殞後，仍不斷在人間走動，盜墳贼欲挖開蕭雲玉墳墓盜取陪葬珠寶，終被蕭雲玉追殺致死...

programme.title: 死囚 / The Condemned
programme.desc: 流浪漢馮大剛被誤指為劫匪，遭逮捕後關押於死囚牢。真正的劫匪為了滅口，賄賂獄中扒手楊靈對馮大剛下毒手。楊靈明白馮大剛是冤枉的，於是暗中設法幫助他逃獄。誰料逃獄計劃意外失敗，最終兩人反而成為真正的死囚。.

programme.title: 花田錯 / The Bride Napping
programme.desc: 故事講述千金小姐劉月英與丫鬟春蘭同遊花田盛會，邂逅橋邊畫畫的落拓書生卞濟。春蘭眼見小姐芳心暗許，於是穿針引線，欲促成良緣，卻因老家僕錯認小霸王周通為卞濟，使小姐與卞濟情路波折重重。在經過一連串誤會與錯配後，結局乃皆大歡喜。.

programme.title: 飛刀手 / The Flying Dagger
programme.desc: 綽號飛刀追魂的焦雷與乾坤劍名手于遠結怨，焦要追殺于全家。幸得飛刀手楊青救了于的女兒于英；但楊青生性風流，向于英開出對付焦雷的條件是共渡一夜。于英憎惡他，又不得不和他一起助父親與焦雷決鬥。相處日久，于英才明白楊非登徒浪子，實對她深愛非常。.

programme.title: 七仙女 / A Maid From Heaven
programme.desc: 故事描述少年董永賣身傳員外家，為奴以埋父骨；其孝心感動了七仙女，便幻成村姑，在六位仙姐下凡暗助下，為董縮減償還工作日，回復自由後，二人回董故家，但愉快的凡間生活能持續多久呢？.

programme.title: 幪面大俠 / That Man In Chang-an
programme.desc: 漢高祖死後,呂后專權,密詔太尉設法殺死代王劉恆。幪面大俠發現其詭計後，馬上告知劉恆。劉於是急遣護衛保護公主往長安求援。太尉率大隊軍馬沿途追殺公主,幸得幪面大俠保護,處處化險為夷。最後，幪面大俠更助劉恆成功繼承漢室大統。.

programme.title: 何日君再來 / Till the End of Time
programme.desc: 富家子卓明不顧父親反對，與歌女雪玲結婚，並因此與家庭斷絕關係。婚後，雪玲懷孕，卓明因過度勞累導致視力衰退。為維持家計，雪玲重操舊業登台演唱，而卓明不願拖累妻子，選擇悄然離開。在友人鼓勵下，雪玲再次公開獻唱，卓明深受感動，最終與妻兒重逢。.

programme.title: 滿天神佛 / Ghosts Galore
programme.desc: 一次驅鬼時，青年術士魯興與友人因功力太差被女鬼戲弄險告喪命，幸得連大師施法幫助，才將女鬼驅逐。於是二人馬上拜他為師。友人意外地被日本忍者所殺，魯興決定要學習絕世茅術，與大師一起對付殘暴的忍者，因而引發終極亂鬥！.

programme.title: 青春萬歲 / The Singing Escort
programme.desc: 青年歌手趙克仁被夜總會老闆委托，到日本尋找他的女兒秋婷。克仁在日本遇到了少女花子、表妹荔萍、女歌手蘇珊、以及冒認是秋婷的女子。克仁愛上了蘇珊。當老闆親自去日本，便認出了蘇珊就是他的女兒秋婷...

programme.title: 海軍突擊隊 / The Naval Commandos
programme.desc: 故事描述二次大戰日軍侵佔上海，中國海軍力量薄弱，難以跟日艦抗衡；為保存戰力，在長江布下水雷，將一艘魚雷快艇偽裝成漁船，乘夜突襲...

programme.title: 乾隆皇與三姑娘 / Emperor Chien Lung and the Beauty
programme.desc: 乾隆皇愛慕蘇州名妓三姑娘，為了朝夕幽會，竟然在青樓挖了一條地下通道直達紫禁城。青樓內外，乾隆神出鬼沒，嚇破臣下的膽子。乾隆在民間行俠仗義，更在賭坊大破賭局。.

programme.title: 盜皇陵 / The Imperial Tomb Raiders
programme.desc: 一個身手不凡的獨行客與一隊英姿颯爽的娘子軍，合力對抗一羣張牙舞爪的土匪，成功阻止皇帝的陵墓被盜。.

programme.title: 盜皇陵 / The Imperial Tomb Raiders
programme.desc: 一個身手不凡的獨行客與一隊英姿颯爽的娘子軍，合力對抗一羣張牙舞爪的土匪，成功阻止皇帝的陵墓被盜。.

programme.title: 摩登土佬 / Disco Bumpkins
programme.desc: 這部音樂喜劇講述青年貝小芬與好友漢堡飽在廣告界內尋找真愛和成就的故事。.

programme.title: 黑店 / The Black Tavern
programme.desc: 故事講述，江湖上傳出消息，巡撫海剛峰辭官歸里，所攜箱篋中珠寶價值連城，於是引起了一些歹人的覬覦。高家店店主高山峰、其姘婦鄧三娘，以及數幫黑道人物，均於高家店埋伏，準備等待海剛峰經過之時伺機下手….

programme.title: 北地胭脂 / Facets Of Love
programme.desc: 本片由三個發生在妓院「百花樓」的單元故事組成。〈花街柳巷〉講述妓女大琴不甘淪落為娼，竟冒險向巡官告狀，要求救她脫離火坑；〈滿宮春色〉講述同治皇帝大婚之前，往妓院尋歡，終於染上梅毒不治；〈游龍豔史〉講述正德皇帝與名妓佛動心同入鴛帳...

programme.title: 喬太守亂點鴛鴦譜 / The Comedy of Mismatches
programme.desc: 孫玉郎與劉慧娘，裴政與徐雅本是兩對情投意合的戀人，陰差陽錯間，孫玉郎男扮女裝代姊拜堂，劉慧娘則代兄娶妻。他們的婚約誤配，讓成誤會，終鬧上公堂，喬太守將錯就錯，乾脆來了一個亂點，結果正好有情人終成眷屬，皆大歡喜。.

programme.title: 黑蜥蜴 / The Black Lizard
programme.desc: 本片改編自著名武俠小說家黃鷹之同名小說。故事講述，丁鵬與蕭立本是同門師兄弟，而丁妻與蕭妻則是兩姊妹。兩家本極為友好，後來丁妻誕下一子，而蕭妻誕下一女，但蕭獨喜子。丁妻為了成全姐夫心願，便來一個男女對換，惟完成此事後便告死去。蕭妻內心有愧，手抱兒子往見丁，不料為蕭暗中看見，頓生綠帽疑雲，狠然佈下瘋子殺母之計，以加害丁家...

programme.title: 佛跳牆 / The Mad Monk (1977)
programme.desc: 故事共有四個單元，講述濟公四出助人的善行，包括幫助一對母女避過倒塌的石牆，助菜販免受惡霸的滋擾，又為年青人尋回被盜的金錢，更以巧計教訓胡作非爲的相爺父子。.

programme.title: 五大漢 / Five Tough Guys
programme.desc: 一班不打不相識之眾，聚集在一起以保護愛國將軍免被加害。他們充當將軍的護送人員，前往危險的遠方英國領事館，途中遭到敵人和日軍的陰險干擾。.

programme.title: 鬥氣小神仙 / Puppy Love
programme.desc: 丁安安與雍晴兩個表姐妹自小就讀於同一所女校，因二人的母親一向口和心不和，從小就向自己女兒灌輸好勝思想，因此形成安安與晴從小鬥到大，三日一小吵，五日一大鬥。她們在校中認識了男同學米高及保羅，很快成為情侶，兩對小冤家後來因鬥氣竟然互調了男朋友….

programme.title: 惡爺 / The Bully
programme.desc: 故事講述，惡少洪毛九不時到蘇記飯店滋事搗蛋，蘇老闆欺善怕惡，把滿腔氣憤發洩在夥記阿七身上。後阿七發覺小廚師張彪武功不凡，遂暗中模仿其動作練武；一日洪毛九又來飯店滋擾，阿七施展出所練功夫打得洪毛九狼狽而逃….

programme.title: 大盜歌王 / The Singing Thief
programme.desc: 一名珠寶神偷棄邪歸正，搖身一變成為夜總會歌手。發生連串搶劫案後，他馬上又成為嫌疑犯。於是，神偷設計捉拿冒認者，最終會否連累自己？.

programme.title: 玉女親情 / A Place to Call Home
programme.desc: 故事講述張愛珠無意得知自己是孤兒，故往找生母。生母茱莉與流氓劉老四同居，老四心起歪念，竟欲非禮愛珠，茱莉救了女兒，卻被老四誤殺。愛珠逃回養父母家，始深深體會到養父母對她的愛。.

programme.title: 江湖了斷 / Pursuit of a Killer
programme.desc: 故事描述，羅莽、尹相林、強漢、湯鎮宗及左燕翎五人偷渡赴港時，湯不慎誤踏陷阱，羅等欲救不果，看駐軍逼近，只得舍湯而去。四人到港後，三男淪為黑幫打手，一次私下行劫時，失手被捕入獄。尹、強出獄後即被殺害，督察白彪疑是仇家所為，遂提前釋放羅，企圖引出兇手...

programme.title: 香港73 / Hong Kong 73
programme.desc: 1973年，香港股市暴漲人人熱衷炒賣股票，小市民因急於入住廉租屋而被不法之徒騙取金錢，及教育制度不健全引起民怨等均被改編成電影中的情節。故事諷刺寫實，反映了香港當時的真實面貌！.

programme.title: 六刺客 / Six Assassins
programme.desc: 鎮國公李明恃強作惡，魚肉百姓。他的兄長雖是當今聖上，卻對李明的惡行束手無策。正氣凜然的劍客穆俊傑假扮成李明的護衛密謀刺殺行動。他先捉拿六名欲殺李明的刺客，再與他們結盟，密謀殺死李明以終止其暴行。.

programme.title: 武則天 / Empress Wu
programme.desc: 武則天有傾國之貌，絕世才華，十四歲時更被唐太宗召為才人，但太宗死後卻入寺為尼，卻又與繼位之唐高宗有染，生有二子。時皇后與蕭妃爭寵，命武則天回宮以制妃子，卻反陷害皇后。武則天獲封皇后之後，更誅殺兩太子。直到高宗病亡，武后臨朝，成為史上第一個女皇帝。.

programme.title: 武則天 / Empress Wu
programme.desc: 武則天有傾國之貌，絕世才華，十四歲時更被唐太宗召為才人，但太宗死後卻入寺為尼，卻又與繼位之唐高宗有染，生有二子。時皇后與蕭妃爭寵，命武則天回宮以制妃子，卻反陷害皇后。武則天獲封皇后之後，更誅殺兩太子。直到高宗病亡，武后臨朝，成為史上第一個女皇帝。.

programme.title: 陰陽刀 / Twin Blades Of Doom
programme.desc: 大俠張七郎退隱江湖多年，他的妻兒及朋友卻被鬼頭黨所殺。悲憤的七郎打算獨力與鬼王決一生死，為他們報仇雪恨！惡名昭彰的鬼頭黨最終會被他打敗嗎？.

programme.title: 遺產五億圓 / The 5 Billion Dollar Legacy
programme.desc: 故事講述三女意外獲得大筆財產，必須遠赴日本領取，途中遇上三位男人，也想分一杯羹。正當大家各懷鬼胎，彼此攻擊、賄賂甚至出賣對方，企圖獨佔鉅款時，殊不知更驚悚的遭遇正嚴陣以待。.

programme.title: 鬼太監 / The Eunuch
programme.desc: 鬼太監桂德海追殺世子朱锦，朱锦得青竹叟相救才倖免於難。桂當年與啞巴月仙誕下一女燕燕，桂竟利用父女之情，假借燕燕之手殺朱锦...

programme.title: 小子有種 / My Rebellious Son
programme.desc: 貪官為討好一群西方人，設計攫取鎮中廟宇的寶貴佛像。幸得張德泰醫師及其兒子張小泰二人合力利用中國功夫，先破西洋拳，再敗日本劍道，然後大勝西洋劍，最終才可保住佛像。.

programme.title: 後門 / Rear Entrance
programme.desc: 本片由著名文學家徐籲的小說《後門》改編，故事講述徐天鶴與太太結婚多年，膝下猶虛，對隔壁小女孩阿琳甚有好感。阿琳父母離婚，孤苦伶仃，徐太太提議收阿琳為繼女，琳父母喜不自勝。後來阿琳親母史小姐出現，要接回阿琳；徐太太不忍拆散母女骨肉，毅然將阿琳交回親母。.

programme.title: 五遁忍術 / Five Elements Ninjas
programme.desc: 東瀛武士挑戰武林盟主袁增，戰敗後切腹自盡。忍者之王劍淵率領忍者渡海復仇，並佈下威力驚人的「五遁忍術」奇陣。袁增門下高手不諳忍術詭計，貿然迎戰竟全軍覆沒。倖存弟子潛心鑽研五遁之法，誓要以其人之道還治其人之身，破陣雪恥。.

programme.title: 乾隆下揚州 / The Voyage of Emperor Chien Lung
programme.desc: 乾隆皇繼續微服南巡，這次得大臣和大學士陪行，他們一行三人來到揚州，期間遇上不少趣事。.

programme.title: 金臂童 / The Kid with the Golden Arm
programme.desc: 虎威鏢局總鏢頭楊虎雲受官府之託，押运二十萬兩黃金赴黃河流域賬災，武林豪傑「長斧」殷九、「短斧」方十、「冷月劍」冷鳳、「寒星劍」李青冥等紛紛前來助陣。當時「七殺谷」中一批武功高強的劇盜，早就佈署截劫詭計，鏢隊幸得「千面神捕」海濤沿途暗中出手相助，化險為夷...

programme.title: 我愛金龜婿 / We Love Millionaires
programme.desc: 三個香港美少女何莉莉、陳依齡及淩雲，帶著愛情夢遠赴日本大阪，一心指望釣得如意郎君。豈料三人被誤會是富家千金，結果惹出趣事連篇。.

programme.title: 隱身女俠 / Shadow Girl
programme.desc: 年輕女劍客服下奶奶研製的隱身藥後，變成白天隱形晚上現身的怪人。她無意中搗亂了黑道首領女兒的婚事，惹來連番追殺。女劍客最後如何脫險？.

programme.title: 扭計祖宗陳夢吉 / Two Con Men
programme.desc: 華南影帝張瑛與梁天合作的清末喜劇，二人分飾師爺荒唐鏡及奇人陳夢吉。陳得知荒平素極盡斂財害人之能事，遂喬扮應徵僕人...

programme.title: 風流斷劍小小刀 / The Deadly Breaking Sword
programme.desc: 大俠段長青在一小鎮得遇名妓柳銀絮，柳懇求段殺死現以「神醫」為名的黑道高手郭天勝，為其未婚夫報仇。段聯同鎮內賭坊護衛高門殺入郭家，正邪兩派惡鬥連場。.

programme.title: 軍閥趣史 / The Scandalous Warlord
programme.desc: 此片可謂李翰祥導演，經典作《大軍閥》之延續，焦點在幾位當時得令的豔星，餘莎莉、邵音音及楚湘雲。片中「豔趣」特別多….

programme.title: 決殺令 / Judgement of an Assassin
programme.desc: 百毒派銳意製造武林不和，以實現稱霸江湖的野心。他們派出蒙面刺客殺戮另一門派，但其中一名刺客被捕後即被其他門派公審。最後審訊結果是什麼？最終又能否揭開真相？.

programme.title: 決殺令 / Judgement of an Assassin
programme.desc: 百毒派銳意製造武林不和，以實現稱霸江湖的野心。他們派出蒙面刺客殺戮另一門派，但其中一名刺客被捕後即被其他門派公審。最後審訊結果是什麼？最終又能否揭開真相？.

programme.title: 人蛇鼠 / Fangs of the Cobra
programme.desc: 莊家農場獨子莊士德海外歸來，接手由胡麟管理的產業。胡一直與德之表妹曼玲勾結，圖取莊家產業，並欲利用曼玲美色迷惑德！怎知在阿芬飼養的小蛇「西西」幫助下，反令德與芬結成夫婦。後來胡買來一條專咬人的野老鼠，欲將德之初生嬰兒咬死，「西西」為救嬰兒，與野鼠作殊死搏鬥...

programme.title: 天龍八部 / The Battle Wizard
programme.desc: 大理國王子段譽不懂武功，卻私自離宮闖蕩江湖。途中，段譽先後遇上玩蛇姑娘鍾靈和同父異母的姊姊木婉清。因緣際會下，段譽吸光朱蝮蟒的血和吃下碧血蛤，得到了絕世功力，最終更擊敗父親的多年仇敵黃袍人。.

programme.title: 老夫子奇趣錄 / Mr. Funnybone Strikes Again
programme.desc: 電影承上集繼續笑料百出。這次，大蕃薯開了一家中醫診所，但傳統的中醫似乎不為時髦的香港社會接受。最後得靠好友老夫子相助，為他解決疑難！.

programme.title: 阿牛出獄記 / Return of the Crazy Bumpkins
programme.desc: 續集中阿牛不幸的遭遇更令人心痛，當中不少更是笑中有淚的經歷。阿牛出獄後，再遇愛人阿花，可惜她已嫁為人妻；另一方面，戇直的阿牛仍不斷被狡猾的周大叔欺騙...

programme.title: 瘋猴 / Mad Monkey Kung Fu
programme.desc: 陳百精通「猴拳」，但卻被惡霸設計陷害，更廢了他雙手。陳百終淪落為流浪藝人，直到遇上街頭小子小侯，決將一身「猴拳」，傾囊相授。最後師徒二人聯手，勢要一雪前恥。.

programme.title: 雙星伴月 / The Happy Trio
programme.desc: 鄉村少女阿嬌、流浪漢大傻、收山老倌二叔公三人同住危樓，生活清苦但互相扶持。其後阿嬌被捧爲歌星，從此飛黃騰達，但她却漸漸發覺自己失去了最重要的東西...

programme.title: 搏盡 / Godfather of Canton
programme.desc: 碼頭工人林四海，一次助中央特派專員鄭志成脫險，因而得以加入警局；後告發要員收規，獲局長賞識，升為副官；繼而林藉局長三姨太欠下巨額賭債，唆使局長允其代受賄替三姨太還債；林辭去職務在黑道大展拳腳，復與碼頭總管事梅寶聯盟…….

programme.title: 藍與黑 / The Blue and the Black
programme.desc: 抗日戰爭期間，少年孤女唐琪愛上青年張醒亞。家庭的壓力與戰爭的動盪令這對有情人飽受煎熬。直至唐琪不幸被強姦，不容於家庭, 而唯有走上夜總會歌女的不歸路...

programme.title: 鬼馬兩金剛 / Crazy Nuts Of Kung Fu
programme.desc: 一名強盜和一位居無定所的賭徒合作以賭賺錢。一天，他們成功從叛國軍閥屋裡偷取一大筆金錢，途中卻遇上革命戰士，並希望他們能資助革命叛軍計劃。二人是否會用偷來的財富協助革命戰士？.

programme.title: 鱷魚河 / Crocodile River
programme.desc: 這個故事洋溢著《羅密歐與茱麗葉》般的悲戀色彩。兩個世代積怨已深的家族，被一條遍佈鱷魚的河流阻隔，誰也不願築橋往來。然而，命運卻讓兩家子女在大學裡邂逅並深深相愛。為了相守，他們不僅必須跨越險惡的河流，更要化解兩個家族間延續多年的仇恨。.

programme.title: 方世玉與胡惠乾 / The Shaolin Avengers
programme.desc: 武當派敗類白眉道人、馮道德、雷老虎等，勾結清廷，甘受驅使來殘殺武林中人，方世玉之父母方濟亨、苗翠花，胡惠乾之父皆為雷等所殺；胡一次尋仇不遂，為方所救，後隨方往少林寺練就高強武功...影片最後少林與武當之武林自相殘殺的畫面，出現一幕令人怵目驚心的大結局。.

programme.title: 我們戀愛去了 / Let's Fall In Love
programme.desc: 一次偶然機會下，富家子大用巧遇育幼院院長之外甥女連蓮。二人初次見面，雙方即發生誤會，大用更在匆忙間遺下皮包。當大用硬將連蓮假裝成爲自己的未婚妻好讓兩個傾慕他的女子死心時，又與連蓮發生了第二次誤會...

programme.title: 追魂鏢 / Killer Darts
programme.desc: 故事描述青虹大俠劉文龍的徒弟鬍子峰不耐孤寂生活，非禮殺害村婦後逃走。劉收婦遺孤玉蟬為徒，玉蟬長大後與劉子玉郎相愛，但玉蟬偶遇胡，誤信劉是殺母仇人….

programme.title: Ketika Waktu Bermain-Main Dengan Cinta
programme.desc: Alami kecelakaan dan menjadi amnesia, Salma tak sadar bahwa ia sudah tiga tahun menjalani pernikahan dengan Wisnu dan dikaruniai seorang anak. Namun saat ingatannya pulih, Salma justru tak mengakui Wisnu dan masih mencintai pria yang ia sukai tiga tahun lalu. Lantas seperti apa kisahnya?

programme.title: Takut Banget Ketempelan Mba Telur Ayam
programme.desc: Naya Gadis muda pekerja keras yang cantik tersebut bekerja sehari-hari di peternakan telur dan menyuplai telur ke toko-toko. Meski pekerjaannya berat dan bukanlah pekerjaan yang bergengsi, tapi Naya melakukan tugasnya dengan penuh rasa bahagia. Pada suatu hari,Naya masuk ke sebuah toko langganannya yang memesan telur ayamnya. Tanpa sengaja menabrak Aldo yang sedang terburu-buru hingga akhirnya telur yang dibawa oleh Naya jatuh ke lantai. Aldo yang berpenampilan rapi dan klimis seperti layaknya para pekerja kantoran. Aldo marah karena bajunya yang bersih terkena noda telur ayam yang pecah akibat ulah Naya yang ceroboh.

programme.title: Bidadari Surgamu
programme.desc: Menceritakan kisah seorang gadis bernama Sakinah yang menjalani hidup penuh tekanan karena fitnah dan dipaksa menikah dengan orang yang tidak mencintainya. Tidak hanya itu, Sakinah bahkan dihalangi untuk tau siapa Ibu kandung yang tega membuangnya. Bagaimana kelanjutan kisah hidup Sakinah?

programme.title: Cinta Dua Pilihan
programme.desc: Fathir dan Sukma adalah sepasang suami istri yang hidup sederhana namun bahagia. Sampai akhirnya sang buah hati Zahra divonis menderita sakit yang serius ditengah keluarga mereka yang masih serba kekurangan. Disaat bersamaan, Fathir tidak sengaja bertemu dengan mantannya Clara. Kehadiran Clara mengubah segalanya.

programme.title: Naik Ranjang
programme.desc: Setelah terpisah selama 20 tahun, Tyas berusaha mencari ayahnya, Mahdi, untuk menjadi wali pernikahannya dengan Gino. Setelah bertemu Mahdi, tunangan Tyas, Gino tampak terkejut menemukan Hani, adik Tyas yang telah memiliki anak dari hubungan mereka di masa lalu.

programme.title: Ditembak Cinta Pake Botol, Dor Dor Dor
programme.desc: Yuni sudah pasrah dengan jodoh hingga membuat permintaan yang ditulis di kertas dalam botol dan dilemparkan ke sungai. Benny yang menemukannya membuat Yuni kesal karena sebelumnya pernah terlibat pertengkaran di jalan. Yuni pun menolak membantu Benny dan berakhir penuh kesialan.

programme.title: Halu Sama Mas Tour Guide, Resiko Tanggung
programme.desc: Viola (Larasati Nugroho) pekerja keras, cantik, dan baik hati memiliki seorang kekasih bernama Tomi (Jorgie Kasenda) berselingkuh. Pada hari ulang tahun Tomi, Viola yang akan memberikan kue ulang tahun, dikejutkan dengan melihat Tomi yang sedang berselingkuh dengan wanita lain. Viola yang mengetahui bahwa ia bukan anak kandung dari wanita yang dipanggilnya Mama, berusaha mencari kakak kandungnya yang terpisahkan. Hal tersebut membuat Viola hijrah ke sebuah desa yang sejuk. Saat bekerja di puskesmas, Viola bertemu dengan seorang pria bernama Aris (Lavicky Nicholas).

programme.desc: Terus menerus di desak oleh orang tuanya membuat Arya nekat mau mengutarakan isi hatinya pada Diana, tapi ternyata Diana malah dijemput pacarnya. Hancur hati Arya. Arya akhirnya berpikir untuk berpura-pura memiliki pacar. Arya teringat Dinda, penjual bunga yang selalu bersemangat. Arya pun mendekati Dinda dan menawarkan kesepakatan yang menurutnya sangat menguntungkan.

programme.title: Naik Ranjang
programme.desc: Setelah terpisah selama 20 tahun, Tyas berusaha mencari ayahnya, Mahdi, untuk menjadi wali pernikahannya dengan Gino. Setelah bertemu Mahdi, tunangan Tyas, Gino tampak terkejut menemukan Hani, adik Tyas yang telah memiliki anak dari hubungan mereka di masa lalu.

programme.title: Ketika Waktu Bermain-Main Dengan Cinta
programme.desc: Alami kecelakaan dan menjadi amnesia, Salma tak sadar bahwa ia sudah tiga tahun menjalani pernikahan dengan Wisnu dan dikaruniai seorang anak. Namun saat ingatannya pulih, Salma justru tak mengakui Wisnu dan masih mencintai pria yang ia sukai tiga tahun lalu. Lantas seperti apa kisahnya?

programme.title: Naik Ranjang

programme.title: Ditembak Cinta Pake Botol, Dor Dor Dor
programme.desc: Yuni sudah pasrah dengan jodoh hingga membuat permintaan yang ditulis di kertas dalam botol dan dilemparkan ke sungai. Benny yang menemukannya membuat Yuni kesal karena sebelumnya pernah terlibat pertengkaran di jalan. Yuni pun menolak membantu Benny dan berakhir penuh kesialan.

programme.title: Halu Sama Mas Tour Guide, Resiko Tanggung
programme.desc: Viola (Larasati Nugroho) pekerja keras, cantik, dan baik hati memiliki seorang kekasih bernama Tomi (Jorgie Kasenda) berselingkuh. Pada hari ulang tahun Tomi, Viola yang akan memberikan kue ulang tahun, dikejutkan dengan melihat Tomi yang sedang berselingkuh dengan wanita lain. Viola yang mengetahui bahwa ia bukan anak kandung dari wanita yang dipanggilnya Mama, berusaha mencari kakak kandungnya yang terpisahkan. Hal tersebut membuat Viola hijrah ke sebuah desa yang sejuk. Saat bekerja di puskesmas, Viola bertemu dengan seorang pria bernama Aris (Lavicky Nicholas).

programme.title: Hilang Untuk Kembali
programme.desc: Demi merebut kembali tanah yang diambil oleh sahabat Ayahnya, Erin nekat pergi ke Bali mencari teman Ayahnya tersebut. Sesampainya disana Erin ditabrak sebuah mobil yang ternyata adalah sahabat Ayahnya yang ia cari. Erin pun menggunakan kesempatan itu dengan sebaik-baiknya sehingga ia bisa tinggal bersama Pak Hutomo. Namun niat merebut kembali surat tanah Ayahnya tersebut, Erin justru jatuh cinta dengan anak Pak Hutomo yang bernama Bagas.

programme.title: Cinta Dua Pilihan
programme.desc: Fathir dan Sukma adalah sepasang suami istri yang hidup sederhana namun bahagia. Kehadiran Clara mengubah segalanya.

programme.title: Aku Menikah Tapi Selalu Merasa Sendiri
programme.desc: Cinta (Ina Marika) terjebak dalam pernikahan penuh luka. Bagas (El Ryan), suami Cinta mengabaikan dan mengkhianati Cinta dengan berselingkuh dengan Tiara (Angbeen Rishi). programme.title: Puzzle Code Of Shanmiao And Jimi
programme.desc: ShanMiao dan JiMi bekerja sama untuk memecahkan teka-teki sementara GuLi dan XinKe yang nakal terus membuat masalah! Malaikat kecil dan pengacau yang egois menghadapi tantangan dengan cara yang berbeda untuk mencapai impian mereka. Kode teka-teki, siapa yang akan menjadi pemenang akhir?

programme.title: Tim Penyelamat Tayo
programme.desc: Pergi tim penyelamat! Lindungi kota! Kendaraan penyelamat baru, mobil polisi, dan truk pemadam kebakaran datang untuk menyelamatkan!

programme.title: Howie, Landau'S Adventures In Seabed
programme.desc: Saatnya Ash dan Pikachu memulai petualangan mereka di wilayah Kalos! Sepanjang jalan, mereka bergabung dengan beberapa teman baru seorang penemu jenius bernama Clemont, adik perempuannya Bonnie, dan Serena, seorang Pelatih dalam perjalanan pertamanya. Ash segera mencoba menantang Gym di Lumiose City, tetapi tidak terlalu jauh sebelum robot mengusirnya! Di sela-sela pertarungan Gym, Ash dan teman-temannya akan menjelajahi wilayah unik ini, bertemu semua jenis Pokemon baru, dan mencari misteri Pokemon baru yang menarik!

programme.title: Boboiboy Season 2
programme.desc: Seorang anak laki-laki menggunakan teknologi alien yang mengubahnya menjadi pahlawan super, saat ia bertempur melawan alien yang kecanduan biji kakao.

programme.title: Pororo Season 7
programme.desc: Mengisahkan tentang petualangan Pororo dan teman-temannya yang tinggal di desa bersalju Porong Porong Forest, yang sering menghadapi tantangan serta mempelajari pelajaran praktis dan moral dalam setiap episode.

programme.title: Tayo The Little Bus- Season 7
programme.desc: Di kota besar di mana berbagai kendaraan hidup bahagia bersama, bus kecil Tayo baru saja mulai mempelajari rutenya di kota. Ada banyak lagi yang harus dipelajari untuk Tayo. Tayo dan teman-temannya yang ramah, Rogi, Lani, dan Gani saling membantu untuk menjadi bus dewasa yang hebat.

programme.title: Pororo Super Super Show
programme.desc: Eddy, apa penemuan terpentingmu? Shark, kenapa kamu selalu mengganggu teman-temanmu? Loopy, apa yang kamu suka lakukan selain memasak? Dalam acara komedi talk show baru ini, teman-teman Porong Porong mengunjungi studio untuk berbincang dengan MC Pororo dan menjawab semua pertanyaanmu!

programme.title: Pororo'S Thematic Show
programme.desc: Tema cerita Pororo dan kawan-kawan. Anda akan diajak ke desa Porong Porong, sebuah tempat yang penuh dengan petualangan.

programme.title: Arpo The Robot Season 3
programme.desc: Ikuti petualangan Mila yang berusia 5 tahun dan hewan peliharaan ajaibnya Morphle, yang dapat berubah menjadi apa pun yang diimpikan Mila!

programme.title: Antiks
programme.desc: Serial ini menggambarkan bagaimana karakter-karakter ini selamat dari bahaya kehidupan sehari-hari, secara tidak sengaja mengubah situasi biasa menjadi peristiwa yang tidak terduga, luar biasa, dan selalu lucu.

programme.title: Morphle - English Season 7
programme.desc: Ikuti petualangan Mila yang berusia 5 tahun dan hewan peliharaan ajaibnya Morphle, yang dapat berubah menjadi apa pun yang diimpikan Mila!

programme.title: Titipo Titipo 2

Meskipun TITIPO bercita-cita menjadi kereta terbaik di dunia, kepribadiannya yang penasaran namun acak menangkapnya dalam peristiwa dan masalah yang tidak terduga setiap hari.

programme.title: Ghostbusters
programme.desc: Armed with proton packs and plenty of attitude, four women (Melissa McCarthy, Kristen Wiig, Leslie Jones, Kate McKinnon) prepare for an epic battle as mischievous ghosts start to wreak havoc in New York. Starring Melissa McCarthy, Kristen Wiig, Leslie Jones.

programme.title: The Craft
programme.desc: Teen misfits befriend a suicidal newcomer and strike back at their tormentors with witchcraft in Los Angeles. Starring Robin Tunney, Fairuza Balk, Neve Campbell.

programme.title: A Nightmare on Elm Street
programme.desc: Freddy Krueger, a badly burned boogeyman with razors on his glove, haunts and kills teens in their dreams. Starring John Saxon, Ronee Blakley, Heather Langenkamp.

programme.title: Outlander: Blood of my Blood
programme.desc: Ellen finds herself a guest among unexpected company; Brian and Murtagh attempt a daring rescue; Colum waits for news of the war; Henry makes an ally of a former enemy.

programme.title: Tip Toe
programme.desc: A showdown in the suburbs as Leo and Clive go face to face for the ultimate confrontation, while George goes to the heart of Manchester to explore his secret life.

programme.title: Fugitive Pieces
programme.desc: A writer (Stephen Dillane) has trouble moving past his haunting memories of the Holocaust. Starring Stephen Dillane, Rade Serbedzija, Rosamund Pike.

programme.title: Clara
programme.desc: In a race to find intelligent life in the universe, an astronomer and his freethinking research assistant make an inexplicable discovery that changes how they see the world -- and each other. Starring Patrick J. Adams, Troian Bellisario, Kristen Hager.

programme.title: Milton's Secret
programme.desc: A man (Donald Sutherland) teaches his 11-year-old grandson (William Ainscough) how to cope with bickering parents and the neighborhood bully. Starring Donald Sutherland, Michelle Rodriguez, Mia Kirshner.

programme.title: Muppets From Space
programme.desc: After learning about his origins, Gonzo must decide whether to seek his own kind or stay with friends. Starring Jeffrey Tambor, F. Murray Abraham, Rob Schneider.

programme.title: Nancy Drew and the Hidden Staircase
programme.desc: Modern, smart, and independent, Nancy Drew reluctantly befriends Helen, the local mean girl, and together they investigate the haunting of Twin Elms. Starring Sophia Lillis, Linda Lavin, Sam Trammell.

programme.title: Twilight
programme.desc: A high-school student is caught up in a romance with a vampire, whose family has renounced the drinking of human blood. Starring Kristen Stewart, Robert Pattinson, Billy Burke.

programme.title: The Twilight Saga: New Moon
programme.desc: After the abrupt departure of Edward, her vampire love, Bella finds comfort in her deepening friendship with Jacob Black. However, Bella's loyalties are put to the test as she becomes drawn into the world of werewolves, ancient enemies of vampires. Starring Kristen Stewart, Robert Pattinson, Taylor Lautner.

programme.title: The Twilight Saga: Eclipse
programme.desc: Bella must choose between Edward and Jacob amid a string of mysterious killings and a malicious vampire's quest for revenge. Starring Kristen Stewart, Robert Pattinson, Taylor Lautner.

programme.title: The Twilight Saga: Breaking Dawn Part 1
programme.desc: A chain of events, set off by Edward and Bella's marriage, honeymoon and birth of a child, yields a shocking development for Jacob. Starring Kristen Stewart, Robert Pattinson, Taylor Lautner.

programme.title: The Twilight Saga: Breaking Dawn Part 2
programme.desc: Bella and Edward gather werewolves, vampires and other allies to help them protect their daughter from the Volturi. Starring Kristen Stewart, Robert Pattinson, Taylor Lautner.

programme.title: BloodRayne
programme.desc: A vampire hybrid joins the fight against the evil bloodsucker who sired her. Starring Kristanna Loken, Michael Madsen, Michelle Rodriguez.

programme.title: I Am Legend
programme.desc: After a man-made plague transforms Earth's population into vampires, a lone survivor desperately searches for a cure. Starring Will Smith, Alice Braga, Dash Mihok.

programme.title: The Perfect Story
programme.desc: Foreign correspondent Michelle Shephard helps young Somali refugee Ismael Abdulle escape his homeland and settle in Harstad, Norway. When he returns to Mogadishu years later, an unexpected turn of events changes everything.

programme.title: The Beast
programme.desc: When a militia plots a coup against the President, he has to quickly learn how to use all the offensive abilities in his armored limousine. Starring Samuel L. Jackson, Guy Burnet.

programme.title: V for Vendetta
programme.desc: After world war leads to a fascist government, a vigilante known as V (Hugo Weaving) uses terrorist tactics to fight the totalitarian state in which he now lives. Starring Natalie Portman, Hugo Weaving, Stephen Rea.

programme.title: Snowtime!
programme.desc: Children (Angela Gallupo, Lucinda Davis, Sonja Ball) in a small village learn valuable life lessons when they form two teams for a massive snowball fight. Starring Angela Galuppo, Lucinda Davis, Sonja Ball.

programme.title: Scooby-Doo! And the Legend of the Vampire
programme.desc: Scooby-Doo (Frank Welker) and the rest of the gang pose as a rock band after a vampire is seen snatching musicians from a concert in Australia. Starring Casey Kasem, Frank Welker, Nicole Jaffe.

programme.title: Scooby-Doo in Where's My Mummy?
programme.desc: Scooby-Doo and the gang travel to Egypt to meet Velma, who is working on the restoration of the Sphinx. They encounter a supernatural curse around Cleopatra's tomb and begin investigating. Starring Frank Welker, Casey Kasem, Mindy Cohn.

programme.title: Scooby-Doo! Stage Fright
programme.desc: Fred and Daphne compete on a hit TV show, broadcast from an opera house with a dark history. After they reach the finals, a vengeful phantom curses the show, and the Mystery Inc. team investigates as the show goes on. Starring Frank Welker, Mindy Cohn, Matthew Lillard.

programme.title: Scooby-Doo! Frankencreepy
programme.desc: A ghost starts to terrorize Scooby (Frank Welker) and the gang after Velma (Mindy Cohn) inherits a castle. Starring Frank Welker, Mindy Cohn, Matthew Lillard.

programme.title: Where the Wild Things Are
programme.desc: Sent to bed without supper, a mischievous boy enters a land that grows out of his imagination and becomes king of the fantastic creatures who live there. Starring Catherine Keener, Max Records, Mark Ruffalo.

programme.title: The Maze Runner
programme.desc: A teen awakes within a massive maze with other teens, with no memory of his past other than dreams about an organization known as WCKD. He hopes to escape by piecing together fragments of his past and clues he discovers in the labyrinth. Starring Dylan O'Brien, Kaya Scodelario, Aml Ameen.

programme.title: Maze Runner: The Scorch Trials
programme.desc: Thomas and his fellow teenage Gladers battle the powerful organization WCKD while facing the perils of the Scorch, a desolate landscape filled with dangerous obstacles and crawling with the virus-infected Cranks. Starring Dylan O'Brien, Kaya Scodelario, Giancarlo Esposito.

programme.title: Maze Runner: The Death Cure
programme.desc: Thomas leads some escaped Gladers on their final and most dangerous mission yet. To save their friends, they must break into the legendary Last City, a WCKD-controlled labyrinth that may turn out to be the deadliest maze of all. Starring Dylan O'Brien, Thomas Brodie-Sangster, Kaya Scodelario.

programme.title: 28 Days Later
programme.desc: Survivors (Cillian Murphy, Noah Huntley, Naomie Harris) try to stay a step ahead of vicious, virus-infected humans that have overrun London. Starring Cillian Murphy, Noah Huntley, Naomie Harris.

programme.title: 28 Weeks Later
programme.desc: As the U.S. Army tries to restore order, a carrier of rage virus enters London and reinfects the populace. Starring Robert Carlyle, Rose Byrne, Jeremy Renner.

programme.title: Outlander: Blood of my Blood
programme.desc: Ellen finds herself a guest among unexpected company; Brian and Murtagh attempt a daring rescue; Colum waits for news of the war; Henry makes an ally of a former enemy.

programme.title: Tip Toe
programme.desc: A showdown in the suburbs as Leo and Clive go face to face for the ultimate confrontation, while George goes to the heart of Manchester to explore his secret life.

programme.title: When Night Is Falling
programme.desc: A bisexual mythology professor (Pascale Bussières) has an affair with a circus performer (Rachael Crawford) she met at a laundromat. Starring Pascale Bussières, Rachael Crawford, Henry Czerny.

programme.title: Monsieur Lazhar
programme.desc: A recent emigrant (Fellag) of Algeria takes over a Canadian classroom after a teacher's tragic death. Starring Mohamed Fellag, Sophie Nélisse, Émilien Néron.

programme.title: Window Horses
programme.desc: Rosie goes on an unwitting journey of forgiveness, reconciliation and understanding. Starring Sandra Oh, Nancy Kwan, Shohreh Aghdashloo.

programme.title: Eve & the Fire Horse
programme.desc: A 9-year-old Chinese girl (Phoebe Jojo Kut) and her older sister (Hollie Lo) embrace their experiences at a Roman Catholic Sunday school. Starring Phoebe Jojo Kut, Hollie Lo, Vivian Wu.

programme.title: Chicken Run
programme.desc: A dashing rooster and the hen he loves lead an escape from a farm in 1950s England. Starring Mel Gibson, Julia Sawalha, Miranda Richardson.

programme.title: Batman: Mask of the Phantasm
programme.desc: Bruce Wayne's former love is implicated in a mysterious new villain's lethal campaign against crime lords. Starring Kevin Conroy, Efrem Zimbalist Jr., Bob Hastings.

programme.title: Scarlet River
programme.desc: An actor (Tom Keene) on the set of a cowboy movie rescues a rancher (Dorothy Wilson) from her foreman (Creighton Chaney). Starring Tom Keene, Dorothy Wilson, Lon Chaney Jr..

programme.title: Carl Laemmle
programme.desc: The extraordinary life story of Carl Laemmle, the German-Jewish immigrant who founded Universal Pictures and saved over 300 Jewish families from Nazi Germany.

programme.title: Frankenstein
programme.desc: Baron Frankenstein creates a monster from cadavers and a killer's brain. Starring Colin Clive, Mae Clarke, John Boles.

programme.title: The Invisible Man
programme.desc: The serum that makes a scientist (Claude Rains) invisible has madness as a side effect. Starring Claude Rains, Gloria Stuart, Henry Travers.

programme.title: The Black Cat
